## Selection Results of $d$ for the d-CCSSBU-S Chart

The d-selection algorithm was applied to Equipment A and Equipment B to identify the recommended value of $d$ for each residue type. The resulting recommendations and corresponding ARL$_1$ performance profiles are presented below.


```{r d-ccssbu-s-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d_ccssbu_s <- function(file,
                       equipment_label = "Equipment A",
                       residue_type = "DAR",
                       sheet = residue_type,

                       # d-CCSSBU-S design parameters
                       d = 3,
                       n_stage3A_events = 10,
                       target_ARL0 = 740,
                       B = 20000,
                       c_smooth = 0.5,
                       h_min = 0.05,
                       seed = 123,

                       # Scale-calibration eligibility and distinct-S_t control
                       scale_eligibility_threshold = 70,
                       scale_distinct_digits = 10,

                       # Cluster definition
                       cluster_col = "USL",
                       cluster_group_cols = NULL,
                       cluster_round_digits = 10,

                       # Input columns
                       event_col = "Event",
                       location_col = "Location",
                       result_col = "Result",
                       lod_col = "LOD",
                       loq_col = "LOQ",
                       usl_col = "USL",

                       # Output controls
                       plot_chart = TRUE,
                       save_outputs = TRUE,
                       output_dir = file.path(getwd(), "d_CCSSBU_S_Charts"),
                       return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
                       keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE) {

  required_pkgs <- c(
    "readxl",
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "stringr",
    "readr",
    "matrixStats"
  )

  missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[
    !(required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
  ]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(matrixStats)

  if (target_ARL0 <= 1) {
    stop("target_ARL0 must be greater than 1.")
  }

  if (B <= 0) {
    stop("B must be positive.")
  }

  if (d < 1) {
    stop("d must be a positive integer.")
  }

  if (n_stage3A_events < 1) {
    stop("n_stage3A_events must be a positive integer.")
  }

  if (c_smooth < 0) {
    stop("c_smooth must be nonnegative.")
  }

  if (h_min < 0) {
    stop("h_min must be nonnegative.")
  }

  if (scale_eligibility_threshold <= 0) {
    stop("scale_eligibility_threshold must be positive.")
  }

  if (save_outputs && !dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper functions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mad_unscaled <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    med_x <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)

    median(
      abs(x - med_x),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }

  is_nd_result <- function(x) {
    x_chr <- trimws(toupper(as.character(x)))

    x_chr %in% c(
      "ND",
      "N.D.",
      "N/D",
      "NON-DETECT",
      "NONDETECT",
      "NON DETECT",
      "NOT DETECT"
    )
  }

  extract_event_number <- function(x) {
    x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))

    x_num_direct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))

    x_num_extracted <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x_chr, "\\d+$"))
    )

    dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(x_num_direct) ~ x_num_direct,
      !is.na(x_num_extracted) ~ x_num_extracted,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  }

  fast_quantile <- function(x, probs) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    as.numeric(
      stats::quantile(
        x = x,
        probs = probs,
        na.rm = TRUE,
        type = 7,
        names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  safe_name <- function(x) {
    gsub(
      pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "_",
      x = as.character(x)
    )
  }

  safe_plot_text <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- gsub("_", "-", x)
    x
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Read data
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  all_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

  if (!(sheet %in% all_sheets)) {
    stop(
      "Requested sheet was not found: ",
      sheet,
      ". Available sheets: ",
      paste(all_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  message("d-CCSSBU-S equipment = ", equipment_label)
  message("Residue type = ", residue_type)
  message("Sheet used = ", sheet)
  message("Cluster column = ", cluster_col)
  message(
    "d = ", d,
    "; n_stage3A_events = ", n_stage3A_events,
    "; target ARL0 = ", target_ARL0,
    "; alpha = ", signif(alpha, 5),
    "; B = ", B,
    "; c_smooth = ", c_smooth,
    "; h_min = ", h_min,
    "; scale eligibility threshold = ", scale_eligibility_threshold,
    "; seed = ", seed
  )

  dat_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    path = file,
    sheet = sheet
  )

  dat_raw <- dat_raw %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_trim(.x))

  result_col_actual <- result_col

  if (!(result_col_actual %in% names(dat_raw)) && residue_type %in% names(dat_raw)) {
    result_col_actual <- residue_type
  }

  required_cols <- c(
    event_col,
    location_col,
    result_col_actual,
    lod_col,
    loq_col,
    usl_col,
    cluster_col
  )

  if (!is.null(cluster_group_cols)) {
    required_cols <- c(required_cols, cluster_group_cols)
  }

  missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required_cols,
    names(dat_raw)
  )

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Sheet ", sheet, " is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 1. Replace non-detects.
  # Step 2. Conduct USL-normalization.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  normalized_data <- dat_raw %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Equipment = equipment_label,
      ResidueType = residue_type,
      Event = extract_event_number(.data[[event_col]]),
      Location = as.character(.data[[location_col]]),
      Result_chr = trimws(as.character(.data[[result_col_actual]])),
      ND_flag = is_nd_result(Result_chr),
      Result_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Result_chr)),
      LOD = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[lod_col]])),
      LOQ = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[loq_col]])),
      USL = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[usl_col]])),
      Cluster_Value_Raw = .data[[cluster_col]],
      Cluster_Value_Numeric = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[cluster_col]])),
      Cluster_Value = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Cluster_Value_Numeric) ~ as.character(round(Cluster_Value_Numeric, cluster_round_digits)),
        TRUE ~ trimws(as.character(Cluster_Value_Raw))
      ),
      Result_Replacement_Source = dplyr::case_when(
        ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~ "ND replaced by LOD",
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & !is.na(LOQ) ~ "ND replaced by LOQ",
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ) ~ "Removed: ND with missing LOD and LOQ",
        !ND_flag & !is.na(Result_raw) ~ "Observed Result",
        !ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw) ~ "Removed: missing or nonnumeric Result",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Result_ND_Replaced = dplyr::case_when(
        ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~ LOD,
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & !is.na(LOQ) ~ LOQ,
        ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ) ~ NA_real_,
        !ND_flag & !is.na(Result_raw) ~ Result_raw,
        !ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw) ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )

  n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq <- sum(
    normalized_data$ND_flag &
      is.na(normalized_data$LOD) &
      is.na(normalized_data$LOQ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  n_removed_missing_result <- sum(
    !normalized_data$ND_flag &
      is.na(normalized_data$Result_raw),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq > 0) {
    warning(
      n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq,
      " ND row(s) removed because both LOD and LOQ were missing."
    )
  }

  if (n_removed_missing_result > 0) {
    warning(
      n_removed_missing_result,
      " non-ND row(s) removed because Result was missing or nonnumeric."
    )
  }

  normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !(ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ)),
      !(!ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw)),
      !is.na(Event),
      !is.na(USL),
      USL > 0,
      !is.na(Cluster_Value),
      Cluster_Value != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Normalized = 100 * Result_ND_Replaced / USL
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Normalized),
      is.finite(Normalized)
    )

  if (nrow(normalized_data) == 0) {
    stop("No usable observations remain after ND replacement and USL-normalization.")
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster key construction.
  # The manuscript writes DAR clusters. Implementation uses cluster_col,
  # default USL, because practical DAR/CAR/Mic heterogeneity is reflected
  # by USL and sheet/residue_type.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(cluster_group_cols)) {

    normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key = paste(
          ResidueType,
          cluster_col,
          Cluster_Value,
          sep = " | "
        )
      )

  } else {

    group_key_df <- normalized_data %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cluster_group_cols)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::everything(),
          ~ trimws(as.character(.x))
        )
      ) %>%
      as.data.frame()

    group_key <- do.call(
      paste,
      c(group_key_df, sep = " | ")
    )

    normalized_data$d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key <- paste(
      normalized_data$ResidueType,
      group_key,
      cluster_col,
      normalized_data$Cluster_Value,
      sep = " | "
    )
  }

  normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Location,
      Result_chr,
      Result_raw,
      LOD,
      LOQ,
      USL,
      Cluster_Value,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      ND_flag,
      Result_Replacement_Source,
      Result_ND_Replaced,
      Normalized,
      dplyr::everything()
    )

  # Chronological sequence D = {e1, ..., ex}.
  event_levels <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Event) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Event_index = dplyr::row_number()
    )

  normalized_data <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      event_levels,
      by = "Event"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      Event_index,
      Location
    )

  # Check one-event-one-cluster assumption.
  event_cluster_check <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Event, Event_index) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_clusters_in_event = dplyr::n_distinct(d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key),
      cluster_keys = paste(unique(d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_clusters_in_event > 1)

  if (nrow(event_cluster_check) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Some cleaning events belong to more than one d-CCSSBU-S cluster. ",
      "This violates the algorithm's partition assumption. ",
      "Check whether cluster_col = '", cluster_col, "' is constant within each event. ",
      "Example event(s): ",
      paste(head(event_cluster_check$Event, 10), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 3. Define event-level location L_t and scale S_t.
  # In d-CCSSBU-S, S_t is monitored and L_t is diagnostic.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  event_statistics <- normalized_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Event,
      Event_index
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Equipment = dplyr::first(Equipment),
      ResidueType = dplyr::first(ResidueType),
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key = dplyr::first(d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key),
      Cluster_Value = dplyr::first(Cluster_Value),
      L_t = median(Normalized, na.rm = TRUE),
      S_t = mad_unscaled(Normalized),
      Max_Z_t = max(Normalized, na.rm = TRUE),
      Min_Z_t = min(Normalized, na.rm = TRUE),
      m_t = dplyr::n(),
      n_locations_observed = dplyr::n_distinct(Location),
      n_zero_values = sum(Normalized == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_positive_values = sum(Normalized > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_ND_values = sum(ND_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
      all_ND_event = all(ND_flag),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      S_t_distinct_key = round(S_t, scale_distinct_digits),
      Scale_Calibration_Eligible = Max_Z_t < scale_eligibility_threshold
    )

  x <- nrow(event_statistics)

  if (x < n_stage3A_events) {
    stop(
      "At least ", n_stage3A_events,
      " eligible cleaning events are required. Current number of eligible events x = ",
      x,
      "."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 4. Define nominal D_3A and D_3B.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  D_3A_event_index <- seq_len(n_stage3A_events)
  D_3A_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[D_3A_event_index]

  if (x == n_stage3A_events) {
    D_3B_event_index <- integer(0)
    D_3B_event_ids <- numeric(0)
    analysis_stage <- "Initial Stage 3A analysis"
  } else {
    D_3B_event_index <- (n_stage3A_events + 1):x
    D_3B_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[D_3B_event_index]
    analysis_stage <- "Stage 3B analysis with post-Stage 3A events available"
  }

  event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      In_D_3A = Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index,
      In_D_3B = Event_index %in% D_3B_event_index
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 5. Define DAR clusters.
  # A cleaning event is eligible for scale calibration only if
  # max_i Z_ti < scale_eligibility_threshold.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  event_statistics_eligible <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::filter(Scale_Calibration_Eligible)

  if (nrow(event_statistics_eligible) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No event is eligible for d-CCSSBU-S scale calibration. ",
      "All events have Max_Z_t >= scale_eligibility_threshold = ",
      scale_eligibility_threshold,
      "."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 6. Order DAR clusters by scale.
  # Clusters are ordered by S_DAR_j = median S_t over eligible events.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cluster_summary <- event_statistics_eligible %>%
    dplyr::group_by(d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key, Cluster_Value) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      S_cluster = median(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      L_cluster_diagnostic = median(L_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_events_cluster = dplyr::n(),
      n_events_cluster_in_D_3A = sum(In_D_3A),
      n_events_cluster_in_D_3B = sum(In_D_3B),
      first_event_index_cluster = min(Event_index, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_S_t_cluster = max(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_S_t_cluster = min(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_distinct_S_t_cluster = dplyr::n_distinct(S_t_distinct_key),
      n_all_ND_events_cluster = sum(all_ND_event, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(S_cluster),
      first_event_index_cluster,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ordered_cluster_rank = dplyr::row_number()
    )

  q <- nrow(cluster_summary)

  if (q == 0) {
    stop("No eligible DAR clusters are available for d-CCSSBU-S calibration.")
  }

  if (d > q) {
    warning(
      "Input d = ", d,
      " is larger than q = ", q,
      ". Setting d = q."
    )
    d <- q
  }

  selected_cluster_keys <- cluster_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(ordered_cluster_rank <= d) %>%
    dplyr::pull(d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key)

  event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      cluster_summary %>%
        dplyr::select(
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
          S_cluster,
          L_cluster_diagnostic,
          ordered_cluster_rank
        ),
      by = "d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      In_first_d_ordered_clusters = d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key %in% selected_cluster_keys
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 7. Construct Stage 3A ordered DAR clusters.
  # For each ordered cluster C_DAR_(j), this is represented by
  # In_D_3A together with ordered_cluster_rank.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Scale_Calibration_Eligible,
      !is.na(ordered_cluster_rank)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_stage3A_component = sum(In_D_3A),
      stage3A_event_index = paste(Event_index[In_D_3A], collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ordered_cluster_rank)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 8. Select ordered-cluster parameter d.
  # d has already been supplied to the function or reduced to q.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 9. Construct the d-CCSSBU-S calibration dataset.
  # For each selected ordered DAR cluster:
  # Rule 9.1: order events by decreasing S_t.
  # Rule 9.2: select distinct S_t values first, with Stage 3A tie priority.
  # Rule 9.3: if fewer than n_3A, fill using repeated S_t values.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  select_cluster_calibration_events <- function(cluster_key_j) {

    candidates <- event_statistics %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Scale_Calibration_Eligible,
        d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key == cluster_key_j
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(S_t),
        dplyr::desc(In_D_3A),
        Event_index
      )

    if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {
      return(
        list(
          selected_index = integer(0),
          selection_detail = data.frame()
        )
      )
    }

    selected_index <- integer(0)
    selected_round <- character(0)

    distinct_keys_order <- candidates %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(S_t_distinct_key)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(S_t_distinct_key, .keep_all = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::pull(S_t_distinct_key)

    # Rule 9.2. Selection Round One.
    for (s_key in distinct_keys_order) {

      if (length(selected_index) >= n_stage3A_events) {
        break
      }

      candidates_s <- candidates %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          S_t_distinct_key == s_key,
          !(Event_index %in% selected_index)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(
          dplyr::desc(In_D_3A),
          Event_index
        )

      if (nrow(candidates_s) > 0) {
        selected_index <- c(selected_index, candidates_s$Event_index[1])
        selected_round <- c(selected_round, "Round 1: distinct S_t")
      }
    }

    # Rule 9.3. Selection Round Two.
    if (length(selected_index) < n_stage3A_events) {

      remaining_candidates <- candidates %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          !(Event_index %in% selected_index)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(
          dplyr::desc(S_t),
          dplyr::desc(In_D_3A),
          Event_index
        )

      if (nrow(remaining_candidates) > 0) {
        for (ii in seq_len(nrow(remaining_candidates))) {

          if (length(selected_index) >= n_stage3A_events) {
            break
          }

          selected_index <- c(
            selected_index,
            remaining_candidates$Event_index[ii]
          )

          selected_round <- c(
            selected_round,
            "Round 2: repeated S_t"
          )
        }
      }
    }

    selection_detail <- candidates %>%
      dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% selected_index) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Selection_Order = match(Event_index, selected_index),
        Selection_Round = selected_round[
          match(Event_index, selected_index)
        ]
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(Selection_Order)

    list(
      selected_index = selected_index,
      selection_detail = selection_detail
    )
  }

  selected_cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(ordered_cluster_rank <= d) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ordered_cluster_rank)

  cluster_selection_list <- lapply(
    selected_cluster_summary$d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
    select_cluster_calibration_events
  )

  names(cluster_selection_list) <- selected_cluster_summary$d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key

  D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster <- lapply(
    cluster_selection_list,
    function(x) {
      x$selected_index
    }
  )

  D_Cal_S_event_index <- sort(unique(unlist(D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster)))

  if (length(D_Cal_S_event_index) == 0) {
    stop(
      "D_Cal,S(d) is empty. Bootstrap limits cannot be estimated. ",
      "Increase d or check the scale eligibility threshold."
    )
  }

  cluster_selection_detail <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_along(cluster_selection_list),
      function(ii) {
        detail_i <- cluster_selection_list[[ii]]$selection_detail

        if (nrow(detail_i) == 0) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        detail_i %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            selected_cluster_key = names(cluster_selection_list)[ii]
          )
      }
    )
  )

  if (is.null(cluster_selection_detail) || nrow(cluster_selection_detail) == 0) {
    cluster_selection_detail <- data.frame()
  }

  cluster_calibration_status <- selected_cluster_summary %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_j = n_events_cluster,
      n_Cal_j = length(
        D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster[[d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key]]
      ),
      calibration_complete_j = n_Cal_j == n_stage3A_events,
      calibration_limited_j = n_Cal_j < n_stage3A_events
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  D_Cal_S_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(D_Cal_S_event_index, event_statistics$Event_index)
  ]

  D_Aug_S_event_index <- sort(
    setdiff(D_Cal_S_event_index, D_3A_event_index)
  )

  D_Aug_S_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(D_Aug_S_event_index, event_statistics$Event_index)
  ]

  n_Cal <- length(D_Cal_S_event_index)

  all_selected_clusters_complete <- all(
    cluster_calibration_status$calibration_complete_j
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 10. Determine calibration status and Cases 1 to 5.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  case_label <- NA_character_
  case_name <- NA_character_
  case_definition <- NA_character_
  calibration_finalized <- FALSE

  if (x == n_stage3A_events && all_selected_clusters_complete) {

    case_label <- "Case 1"
    case_name <- "Initial Stage 3A Complete"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x = n3A and n_Cal,j = n3A for every selected ordered DAR cluster. ",
      "The scale-calibration dataset is finalized using currently available calibration-eligible events."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- TRUE

  } else if (x == n_stage3A_events && !all_selected_clusters_complete) {

    case_label <- "Case 2"
    case_name <- "Initial Stage 3A Calibration Limited"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x = n3A and n_Cal,j < n3A for at least one selected ordered DAR cluster. ",
      "No post-Stage 3A events are available yet. ",
      "The scale-calibration dataset remains provisional."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- FALSE

  } else if (
    x > n_stage3A_events &&
      all_selected_clusters_complete &&
      length(D_Aug_S_event_index) == 0
  ) {

    case_label <- "Case 3"
    case_name <- "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Finalized Without Post-Stage 3A Supplementation"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A, n_Cal,j = n3A for every selected ordered DAR cluster, ",
      "and D_Aug,S(d) is empty. ",
      "The scale-calibration dataset is finalized without using post-Stage 3A events."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- TRUE

  } else if (
    x > n_stage3A_events &&
      all_selected_clusters_complete &&
      length(D_Aug_S_event_index) > 0
  ) {

    case_label <- "Case 4"
    case_name <- "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Finalized With Post-Stage 3A Supplementation"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A, n_Cal,j = n3A for every selected ordered DAR cluster, ",
      "and D_Aug,S(d) is not empty. ",
      "The scale-calibration dataset is finalized after including selected calibration-eligible post-Stage 3A events."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- TRUE

  } else if (
    x > n_stage3A_events &&
      !all_selected_clusters_complete
  ) {

    case_label <- "Case 5"
    case_name <- "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Still Provisional"
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A and n_Cal,j < n3A for at least one selected ordered DAR cluster ",
      "after all currently available calibration-eligible events from that cluster have been exhausted. ",
      "The scale-calibration dataset remains provisional."
    )
    calibration_finalized <- FALSE
  }

  if (case_label == "Case 3") {
    monitoring_event_index <- D_3B_event_index
  } else if (case_label == "Case 4") {
    monitoring_event_index <- setdiff(D_3B_event_index, D_Aug_S_event_index)
  } else {
    monitoring_event_index <- integer(0)
  }

  monitoring_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(monitoring_event_index, event_statistics$Event_index)
  ]

  event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_calibration = Event_index %in% D_Cal_S_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_augmented_calibration = Event_index %in% D_Aug_S_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_monitoring = Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
    )

  limits_estimated <- TRUE
  limits_finalized <- calibration_finalized

  limit_status <- dplyr::case_when(
    case_label == "Case 1" ~
      "Complete d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated from D_Cal,S(d) at initial Stage 3A analysis.",

    case_label == "Case 2" ~
      "Provisional d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated from the currently available D_Cal,S(d). Additional events are required before routine Stage 3B monitoring.",

    case_label == "Case 3" ~
      "Complete d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated from D_Cal,S(d) without post-Stage 3A supplementation.",

    case_label == "Case 4" ~
      "Complete d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated from D_Cal,S(d) with selected post-Stage 3A supplementation.",

    case_label == "Case 5" ~
      "Provisional d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated from the currently available D_Cal,S(d). Additional eligible events may update the chart in a future analysis cycle.",

    TRUE ~
      "d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated from the current D_Cal,S(d)."
  )

  message("Automatic analysis stage: ", analysis_stage)
  message("Case label: ", case_label, " (", case_name, ")")
  message("Case definition: ", case_definition)
  message("Total eligible events x = ", x)
  message("Number of ordered eligible clusters q = ", q)
  message("Selected d = ", d)
  message("Current nCal = ", n_Cal)
  message("Calibration finalized = ", calibration_finalized)
  message("Limits estimated = ", limits_estimated)
  message("Limits finalized = ", limits_finalized)
  message("DCalS event index: ", paste(D_Cal_S_event_index, collapse = ", "))

  if (length(D_Aug_S_event_index) > 0) {
    message("DAugS event index: ", paste(D_Aug_S_event_index, collapse = ", "))
  } else {
    message("DAugS event index: none.")
  }

  if (length(monitoring_event_index) > 0) {
    message("Monitoring event index: ", paste(monitoring_event_index, collapse = ", "))
  } else {
    message("Monitoring event index: none.")
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 11. Define sampling-location-specific calibration strata.
  # Step 12. Generate CCSSB bootstrap events.
  # Step 13. Compute bootstrap scale statistics.
  # Step 14. Estimate d-CCSSBU-S chart parameters.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  calibrate_d_ccssbu_s_bootstrap <- function(calibration_event_index,
                                             seed_internal) {

    set.seed(seed_internal)

    calibration_data <- normalized_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% calibration_event_index)

    if (nrow(calibration_data) == 0) {
      stop("No calibration data available for d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap.")
    }

    loc_data <- split(
      calibration_data,
      calibration_data$Location
    )

    loc_data <- loc_data[
      vapply(
        loc_data,
        function(dloc) {
          any(!is.na(dloc$Normalized) & is.finite(dloc$Normalized))
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    if (length(loc_data) == 0) {
      stop("No valid sampling-location strata are available for bootstrap.")
    }

    loc_data <- loc_data[sort(names(loc_data))]

    h_values <- vapply(
      loc_data,
      function(dloc) {
        z <- dloc$Normalized
        z <- z[!is.na(z) & is.finite(z)]

        h_raw <- c_smooth * mad_unscaled(z)

        if (is.na(h_raw) || !is.finite(h_raw)) {
          h_raw <- 0
        }

        max(h_raw, h_min)
      },
      numeric(1)
    )

    h_values[!is.finite(h_values)] <- h_min

    n_bootstrap_locations <- length(loc_data)

    boot_mat <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = B,
      ncol = n_bootstrap_locations
    )

    colnames(boot_mat) <- names(loc_data)

    for (rr in seq_len(n_bootstrap_locations)) {

      z_r <- loc_data[[rr]]$Normalized
      z_r <- z_r[!is.na(z_r) & is.finite(z_r)]

      if (length(z_r) == 0) {
        stop("A sampling-location stratum has no valid normalized values.")
      }

      sampled_index <- sample.int(
        n = length(z_r),
        size = B,
        replace = TRUE
      )

      sampled_value <- z_r[sampled_index]

      h_r <- h_values[rr]

      eps <- if (is.na(h_r) || !is.finite(h_r) || h_r == 0) {
        numeric(B)
      } else {
        stats::rnorm(
          n = B,
          mean = 0,
          sd = h_r
        )
      }

      boot_mat[, rr] <- pmax(
        0,
        sampled_value + eps
      )
    }

    if (n_bootstrap_locations == 1) {
      S_boot <- rep(0, B)
    } else {
      row_medians <- matrixStats::rowMedians(
        boot_mat,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      S_boot <- matrixStats::rowMedians(
        abs(sweep(boot_mat, 1, row_medians, "-")),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }

    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot <- median(
      S_boot,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot <- fast_quantile(
      S_boot,
      probs = 1 - alpha
    )

    empirical_p0 <- mean(
      S_boot > UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    empirical_ARL0 <- ifelse(
      empirical_p0 > 0,
      1 / empirical_p0,
      Inf
    )

    bootstrap_strata_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(
        names(loc_data),
        function(loc_name) {
          z <- loc_data[[loc_name]]$Normalized
          z <- z[!is.na(z) & is.finite(z)]

          data.frame(
            Location = loc_name,
            n = length(z),
            median = median(z, na.rm = TRUE),
            MAD = mad_unscaled(z),
            h = h_values[loc_name],
            min = min(z, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(z, na.rm = TRUE)
          )
        }
      )
    )

    boot_mat_out <- if (return_bootstrap_matrix) {
      boot_mat
    } else {
      NULL
    }

    S_boot_out <- if (keep_bootstrap_statistics) {
      S_boot
    } else {
      NULL
    }

    list(
      calibration_data = calibration_data,
      bootstrap_strata_summary = bootstrap_strata_summary,
      bootstrap_h_values = h_values,
      bootstrap_scale_matrix = boot_mat_out,
      S_d_ccssbu_s_boot = S_boot_out,
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      empirical_p0_from_bootstrap = empirical_p0,
      empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap = empirical_ARL0,
      n_bootstrap_locations = n_bootstrap_locations,
      bootstrap_location_names = names(loc_data)
    )
  }

  boot_obj <- calibrate_d_ccssbu_s_bootstrap(
    calibration_event_index = D_Cal_S_event_index,
    seed_internal = seed + 1
  )

  calibration_data <- boot_obj$calibration_data
  bootstrap_strata_summary <- boot_obj$bootstrap_strata_summary
  bootstrap_h_values <- boot_obj$bootstrap_h_values
  bootstrap_scale_matrix <- boot_obj$bootstrap_scale_matrix
  bootstrap_statistics <- boot_obj$S_d_ccssbu_s_boot
  CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot <- boot_obj$CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot
  UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot <- boot_obj$UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot
  empirical_p0_from_bootstrap <- boot_obj$empirical_p0_from_bootstrap
  empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap <- boot_obj$empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap
  bootstrap_location_names <- boot_obj$bootstrap_location_names

  CL_obs <- median(
    event_statistics$S_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 15. Construct the d-CCSSBU-S chart.
  # Step 16. Apply Stage 3B monitoring.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  chart_data <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      CL_obs = CL_obs,
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S = S_t > UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      Stage_Status = dplyr::case_when(
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_calibration &
          Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_augmented_calibration ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event used for d-CCSSBU-S scale calibration",

        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_calibration &
          Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event used for d-CCSSBU-S scale calibration",

        !Scale_Calibration_Eligible &
          Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event not eligible for scale calibration",

        !Scale_Calibration_Eligible &
          Event_index %in% D_3B_event_index ~
          "Stage 3B event not eligible for scale calibration",

        Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event not selected for current d-CCSSBU-S calibration",

        Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index ~
          "Stage 3B monitoring event",

        Event_index %in% D_3B_event_index ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event not used for current monitoring set",

        TRUE ~
          "Unclassified event"
      ),
      Limit_Status = limit_status,
      OOC_Event_Label = dplyr::case_when(
        Signal_d_CCSSBU_S ~ paste0("OOC:", Event),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  ooc_events <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_S) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Event_index,
      L_t,
      S_t,
      Max_Z_t,
      Scale_Calibration_Eligible,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value,
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      S_cluster,
      L_cluster_diagnostic,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      CL_obs,
      m_t,
      n_locations_observed,
      all_ND_event,
      Stage_Status,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_calibration,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_augmented_calibration,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_monitoring,
      OOC_Event_Label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index)

  n_ooc_events <- nrow(ooc_events)

  n_stage3A_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S,
      Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  n_stage3B_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S,
      Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  stage3B_ooc_labels <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S,
      Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(OOC_Event_Label)

  if (n_ooc_events > 0) {
    message(
      "Number of candidate OOC cleaning event(s): ",
      n_ooc_events,
      ". Candidate OOC event label(s): ",
      paste(ooc_events$OOC_Event_Label, collapse = ", ")
    )
  } else {
    message("No candidate OOC cleaning events detected.")
  }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot.
  # Subtitle and caption intentionally avoid underscores.
  # Font sizes and point sizes are intentionally smaller for
  # long Equipment B charts with many cleaning events.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  chart_title <- paste0(
    "d-CCSSBU-S for ",
    safe_plot_text(residue_type),
    " of ",
    safe_plot_text(equipment_label)
  )

  chart_subtitle <- paste0(
    safe_plot_text(case_label),
    " | d=", d, "/", q,
    " | nCal=", n_Cal,
    " | UCLboot=", signif(UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, 4),
    " | CLboot=", signif(CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, 4)
  )

  chart_subtitle <- stringr::str_wrap(
    chart_subtitle,
    width = 120
  )

  chart_caption <- paste0(
    "Stage 3A OOC = ", n_stage3A_ooc,
    "; Stage 3B OOC = ", n_stage3B_ooc,
    "; nCal = ", n_Cal,
    "; d = ", d, "/", q,
    "; ",
    ifelse(
      limits_finalized,
      "Finalized limits",
      "Provisional limits"
    )
  )

  chart_caption <- stringr::str_wrap(
    chart_caption,
    width = 100
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot size controls
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  point_size_main <- 0.42
  point_size_aug <- 0.90
  point_stroke_aug <- 0.25

  ooc_label_size <- 2.05
  limit_label_size_ucl <- 2.15
  limit_label_size_cl <- 1.95
  boundary_label_size <- 1.65

  plot_title_size <- 10
  plot_subtitle_size <- 6.5
  plot_caption_size <- 5.8

  legend_title_size <- 6.2
  legend_text_size <- 5.8
  axis_title_size <- 8.2
  axis_text_size <- 6.8

  event_breaks_plot <- pretty(
    chart_data$Event_index,
    n = 10
  )

  event_breaks_plot <- event_breaks_plot[
    event_breaks_plot >= min(chart_data$Event_index) &
      event_breaks_plot <= max(chart_data$Event_index)
  ]

  event_labels <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Event_index, Event) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index)

  y_max_candidates <- c(
    chart_data$S_t,
    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
    CL_obs
  )

  y_max_plot <- max(
    y_max_candidates[is.finite(y_max_candidates)],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  y_upper_plot <- ifelse(
    y_max_plot <= 0,
    1,
    y_max_plot * 1.30
  )

  x_min_plot <- min(chart_data$Event_index, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max_plot <- max(chart_data$Event_index, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_range_plot <- max(1, x_max_plot - x_min_plot)
  x_label_pos <- x_max_plot + 0.025 * x_range_plot

  label_gap <- 0.028 * y_upper_plot

  ucl_label <- paste0("UCLboot = ", signif(UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, 4))
  cl_boot_label <- paste0("CLboot = ", signif(CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, 4))
  cl_obs_label <- paste0("CLobs = ", signif(CL_obs, 4))

  # UCL label is placed slightly above the UCL line,
  # not directly on the line.
  ucl_label_y <- min(
    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot + 0.022 * y_upper_plot,
    y_upper_plot * 0.985
  )

  cl_boot_label_y <- min(
    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot + label_gap,
    y_upper_plot * 0.94
  )

  cl_obs_label_y <- max(
    CL_obs - label_gap,
    y_upper_plot * 0.02
  )

  if (abs(CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot - CL_obs) < 2 * label_gap) {
    cl_boot_label_y <- min(
      max(CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, CL_obs) + 1.3 * label_gap,
      y_upper_plot * 0.94
    )

    cl_obs_label_y <- max(
      min(CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, CL_obs) - 1.3 * label_gap,
      y_upper_plot * 0.02
    )
  }

  ooc_plot_data <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_S) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      OOC_Label_Y = pmax(S_t, UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot) + 0.025 * y_upper_plot
    )

  plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    chart_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = Event_index,
      y = S_t,
      group = 1
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(color = Signal_d_CCSSBU_S),
      size = point_size_main
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = ooc_plot_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = Event_index,
        y = OOC_Label_Y,
        label = OOC_Event_Label
      ),
      color = "red",
      hjust = -0.05,
      vjust = 0,
      size = ooc_label_size,
      check_overlap = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      linetype = "solid",
      color = "blue",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = CL_obs,
      linetype = "dotted",
      color = "grey35",
      linewidth = 0.50
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_max_plot,
      xend = x_label_pos - 0.005 * x_range_plot,
      y = UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      yend = ucl_label_y,
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.28,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_max_plot,
      xend = x_label_pos - 0.005 * x_range_plot,
      y = CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      yend = cl_boot_label_y,
      color = "blue",
      linewidth = 0.28,
      linetype = "solid"
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_max_plot,
      xend = x_label_pos - 0.005 * x_range_plot,
      y = CL_obs,
      yend = cl_obs_label_y,
      color = "grey35",
      linewidth = 0.28,
      linetype = "dotted"
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_label_pos,
      y = ucl_label_y,
      label = ucl_label,
      color = "red",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = limit_label_size_ucl
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_label_pos,
      y = cl_boot_label_y,
      label = cl_boot_label,
      color = "blue",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = limit_label_size_cl
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_label_pos,
      y = cl_obs_label_y,
      label = cl_obs_label,
      color = "grey35",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = limit_label_size_cl
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "FALSE" = "black",
        "TRUE" = "red"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "FALSE" = "In control",
        "TRUE" = "Candidate OOC"
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = event_breaks_plot,
      labels = event_labels$Event[
        match(event_breaks_plot, event_labels$Event_index)
      ]
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_upper_plot),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = chart_title,
      subtitle = chart_subtitle,
      caption = chart_caption,
      x = "Cleaning Event",
      y = expression(S[t]),
      color = "Signal"
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      clip = "off",
      xlim = c(
        x_min_plot,
        x_max_plot + 0.08 * x_range_plot
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(size = 1.1)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = plot_subtitle_size,
        lineheight = 1.05
      ),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = plot_caption_size,
        hjust = 0,
        lineheight = 1.05
      ),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t = 8,
        r = 75,
        b = 8,
        l = 8
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_title_size),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )

  if (x > n_stage3A_events) {

    boundary_x <- n_stage3A_events + 0.5

    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = boundary_x,
        linetype = "dotdash",
        color = "darkgreen",
        linewidth = 0.65
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x = boundary_x + 0.010 * x_range_plot,
        y = y_upper_plot * 0.955,
        label = "Stage 3A / 3B",
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        size = boundary_label_size,
        color = "darkgreen"
      )
  }

  if (length(D_Aug_S_event_index) > 0) {
    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = chart_data %>%
          dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% D_Aug_S_event_index),
        ggplot2::aes(x = Event_index, y = S_t),
        shape = 21,
        fill = "orange",
        color = "black",
        size = point_size_aug,
        stroke = point_stroke_aug
      )
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Output files.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  safe_equipment <- safe_name(equipment_label)
  safe_residue <- safe_name(residue_type)
  safe_cluster <- safe_name(cluster_col)
  safe_c <- gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(c_smooth))
  safe_hmin <- gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(h_min))
  safe_thresh <- gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(scale_eligibility_threshold))

  file_stub <- paste0(
    "d_CCSSBU_S_",
    safe_residue,
    "_",
    safe_equipment,
    "_cluster_",
    safe_cluster,
    "_d_",
    d,
    "_ARL0_",
    target_ARL0,
    "_c_",
    safe_c,
    "_hmin_",
    safe_hmin,
    "_elig_",
    safe_thresh
  )

  chart_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, ".png")
  )

  event_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_event_statistics.csv")
  )

  normalized_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_normalized_data.csv")
  )

  cluster_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_ordered_cluster_summary.csv")
  )

  calibration_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_calibration_events.csv")
  )

  cluster_selection_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_cluster_selection_detail.csv")
  )

  cluster_status_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_cluster_calibration_status.csv")
  )

  bootstrap_strata_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_bootstrap_strata_summary.csv")
  )

  rds_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_fit.rds")
  )

  calibration_event_check <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% D_Cal_S_event_index) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_CCSSBU_S_Calibration_Role = dplyr::case_when(
        Event_index %in% D_Aug_S_event_index ~ "Post-Stage 3A scale-calibration event",
        Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index ~ "Nominal Stage 3A scale-calibration event",
        TRUE ~ "Scale-calibration event"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Event_index,
      L_t,
      S_t,
      Max_Z_t,
      Scale_Calibration_Eligible,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value,
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      S_cluster,
      L_cluster_diagnostic,
      m_t,
      n_locations_observed,
      all_ND_event,
      d_CCSSBU_S_Calibration_Role
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      dplyr::desc(S_t),
      Event_index
    )

  if (save_outputs) {

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = chart_file,
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = 11,
      height = 6.2,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )

    readr::write_csv(chart_data, event_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(normalized_data, normalized_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_summary, cluster_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(calibration_event_check, calibration_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_selection_detail, cluster_selection_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_calibration_status, cluster_status_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(bootstrap_strata_summary, bootstrap_strata_csv_file)
  }

  files <- list(
    chart_file = if (save_outputs) chart_file else NA_character_,
    event_statistics_csv = if (save_outputs) event_csv_file else NA_character_,
    normalized_data_csv = if (save_outputs) normalized_csv_file else NA_character_,
    ordered_cluster_summary_csv = if (save_outputs) cluster_csv_file else NA_character_,
    calibration_events_csv = if (save_outputs) calibration_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_selection_detail_csv = if (save_outputs) cluster_selection_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_calibration_status_csv = if (save_outputs) cluster_status_csv_file else NA_character_,
    bootstrap_strata_summary_csv = if (save_outputs) bootstrap_strata_csv_file else NA_character_,
    rds_file = if (save_outputs) rds_file else NA_character_
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Reusable output object.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  result <- list(

    # Basic identity
    method = "d-CCSSBU-S",
    chart_family = "CCSSBU",
    chart_statistic = "Scale",
    function_name = "d_ccssbu_s",
    call = match.call(),

    # Input identity
    file = file,
    equipment_label = equipment_label,
    residue_type = residue_type,
    sheet = sheet,

    # Stage and case information
    analysis_stage = analysis_stage,
    case_label = case_label,
    case_name = case_name,
    case_definition = case_definition,
    calibration_finalized = calibration_finalized,
    limits_estimated = limits_estimated,
    limits_finalized = limits_finalized,
    limit_status = limit_status,

    # Main design parameters
    d = d,
    q = q,
    selected_ordered_cluster_ranks = seq_len(d),
    selected_cluster_keys = selected_cluster_keys,
    cluster_col = cluster_col,
    cluster_group_cols = cluster_group_cols,
    cluster_round_digits = cluster_round_digits,
    n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
    n_total_events = x,
    target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
    alpha = alpha,
    B = B,
    c_smooth = c_smooth,
    h_min = h_min,
    seed = seed,
    scale_eligibility_threshold = scale_eligibility_threshold,
    scale_distinct_digits = scale_distinct_digits,

    # Stage sets
    D_3A_event_index = D_3A_event_index,
    D_3A_event_ids = D_3A_event_ids,
    D_3B_event_index = D_3B_event_index,
    D_3B_event_ids = D_3B_event_ids,

    # Calibration sets
    D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster = D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster,
    D_Cal_S_event_index = D_Cal_S_event_index,
    D_Cal_S_event_ids = D_Cal_S_event_ids,
    D_Aug_S_event_index = D_Aug_S_event_index,
    D_Aug_S_event_ids = D_Aug_S_event_ids,
    monitoring_event_index = monitoring_event_index,
    monitoring_event_ids = monitoring_event_ids,
    n_Cal = n_Cal,

    # Data objects
    normalized_data = normalized_data,
    event_statistics = chart_data,
    event_statistics_eligible = event_statistics_eligible,
    cluster_summary = cluster_summary,
    stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary = stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary,
    cluster_selection_detail = cluster_selection_detail,
    cluster_calibration_status = cluster_calibration_status,
    calibration_data = calibration_data,
    calibration_event_check = calibration_event_check,
    bootstrap_strata_summary = bootstrap_strata_summary,

    # Main chart parameters
    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot_definition = paste0(
      "Bootstrap center line: median of S_boot estimated from D_Cal,S(d)."
    ),
    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot_definition = paste0(
      "Bootstrap upper control limit: empirical 1 - alpha quantile of S_boot estimated from D_Cal,S(d)."
    ),
    CL_obs = CL_obs,
    CL_obs_definition = paste0(
      "Observed descriptive center line: median of all observed S_t values displayed on the chart. ",
      "It is not used as the monitoring limit."
    ),

    # Bootstrap outputs
    bootstrap_statistics_S = bootstrap_statistics,
    bootstrap_scale_matrix = bootstrap_scale_matrix,
    bootstrap_h_values = bootstrap_h_values,
    bootstrap_location_names = bootstrap_location_names,
    empirical_p0_from_bootstrap = empirical_p0_from_bootstrap,
    empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap = empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap,

    # Signal outputs
    ooc_events = ooc_events,
    n_ooc_events = n_ooc_events,
    n_stage3A_ooc = n_stage3A_ooc,
    n_stage3B_ooc = n_stage3B_ooc,
    stage3B_ooc_labels = stage3B_ooc_labels,

    # Reusable vectors for EWMA, CUSUM, ARL1, and d optimization
    reusable = list(
      all_event_index = chart_data$Event_index,
      all_event_ids = chart_data$Event,
      all_L_t = chart_data$L_t,
      all_S_t = chart_data$S_t,
      all_Max_Z_t = chart_data$Max_Z_t,
      all_cluster_key = chart_data$d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      all_scale_calibration_eligible = chart_data$Scale_Calibration_Eligible,

      D_3A_event_index = D_3A_event_index,
      D_3B_event_index = D_3B_event_index,

      calibration_event_index = D_Cal_S_event_index,
      calibration_event_ids = D_Cal_S_event_ids,
      calibration_L_t = chart_data$L_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_S_event_index
      ],
      calibration_S_t = chart_data$S_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_S_event_index
      ],

      augmented_event_index = D_Aug_S_event_index,
      augmented_event_ids = D_Aug_S_event_ids,

      monitoring_event_index = monitoring_event_index,
      monitoring_event_ids = monitoring_event_ids,
      monitoring_L_t = chart_data$L_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
      ],
      monitoring_S_t = chart_data$S_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
      ],

      bootstrap_S_t = bootstrap_statistics,
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot = UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,

      limits_estimated = limits_estimated,
      limits_finalized = limits_finalized,
      limit_status = limit_status,

      alpha = alpha,
      target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
      B = B,
      c_smooth = c_smooth,
      h_min = h_min,
      scale_eligibility_threshold = scale_eligibility_threshold
    ),

    # Rules for traceability
    d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_rule = paste0(
      "Clusters are defined by residue type and ", cluster_col,
      ". For d-CCSSBU-S, only events with Max_Z_t < ",
      scale_eligibility_threshold,
      " are eligible for scale-calibration construction. ",
      "Clusters are ordered by cluster-level median S_t."
    ),
    d_CCSSBU_S_calibration_rule = paste0(
      "For fixed d, D_Cal,S,j(d) is constructed separately for each of the first d ordered clusters. ",
      "Within each cluster, eligible events are ordered by decreasing S_t. ",
      "Distinct S_t values are selected first, with Stage 3A priority when tied. ",
      "If fewer than n3A events are selected, remaining repeated S_t events are added using the same ordering rule until n3A or exhaustion."
    ),
    d_CCSSBU_S_limit_rule = paste0(
      "Bootstrap limits are estimated from D_Cal,S(d). In Cases 2 and 5, limits are provisional because at least one selected cluster ",
      "has fewer than n3A eligible calibration events."
    ),
    d_CCSSBU_S_monitoring_rule = paste0(
      "Under Case 3, all D3B events are monitoring events. Under Case 4, post-Stage 3A events selected into D_Cal,S(d) ",
      "are used for scale calibration and excluded from routine Stage 3B monitoring. Under Case 2 or Case 5, the chart is provisional."
    ),

    # Plot and files
    chart_title = chart_title,
    chart_subtitle = chart_subtitle,
    chart_caption = chart_caption,
    chart = plot_obj,
    files = files
  )

  class(result) <- c("d_ccssbu_s", "ccssbu_s", "list")

  if (save_outputs) {
    saveRDS(
      object = result,
      file = rds_file
    )
  }

  if (plot_chart) {
    print(plot_obj)
  }

  return(result)
}
```

```{r make-d-ccssbu-s-arl1-wide-tbl-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

make_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_wide_tbl <- function(tbl) {

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "case_label",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "UCL",
    "rho",
    "S_chart_ARL1",
    "ARL1"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop("tbl contains no rows.")
  }

  make_rho_label <- function(x) {

    x_formatted <- formatC(
      x,
      format = "f",
      digits = 2
    )

    gsub(
      pattern = "\\.",
      replacement = "p",
      x = x_formatted
    )
  }

  tbl_wide_input <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rho_label = make_rho_label(rho)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Residue,
      d,
      q,
      case_label,
      nCal,
      OOC_ND,
      OOC_3A,
      OOC_3B,
      benchmark_n,
      UCL,
      rho,
      rho_label,
      S_chart_ARL1,
      ARL1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  duplicate_rows <- tbl_wide_input %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Residue,
      d,
      rho_label,
      name = "n_rows"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_rows > 1
    )

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Multiple rows were found for at least one ",
        "Residue, d, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  inconsistent_ids <- tbl_wide_input %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Residue,
      d
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_q = dplyr::n_distinct(q),
      n_case_label = dplyr::n_distinct(case_label),
      n_nCal = dplyr::n_distinct(nCal),
      n_OOC_ND = dplyr::n_distinct(OOC_ND),
      n_OOC_3A = dplyr::n_distinct(OOC_3A),
      n_OOC_3B = dplyr::n_distinct(OOC_3B),
      n_benchmark_n = dplyr::n_distinct(benchmark_n),
      n_UCL = dplyr::n_distinct(UCL),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_q > 1 |
        n_case_label > 1 |
        n_nCal > 1 |
        n_OOC_ND > 1 |
        n_OOC_3A > 1 |
        n_OOC_3B > 1 |
        n_benchmark_n > 1 |
        n_UCL > 1
    )

  if (nrow(inconsistent_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "One or more d-specific columns vary across rho for ",
        "the same Residue and d combination."
      )
    )
  }

  benchmark_inconsistency <- tbl_wide_input %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Residue,
      benchmark_n,
      rho_label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_benchmark_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(S_chart_ARL1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_benchmark_values > 1
    )

  if (nrow(benchmark_inconsistency) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The S-chart ARL1 benchmark varies across d for at ",
        "least one Residue, benchmark_n, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  id_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "case_label",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "UCL"
  )

  tbl_wide_input %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = dplyr::all_of(id_columns),
      names_from = rho_label,
      values_from = c(
        S_chart_ARL1,
        ARL1
      ),
      names_glue = "{.value}_rho_{rho_label}",
      names_sort = FALSE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      Residue,
      d
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Residue,
      d,
      q,
      case_label,
      nCal,
      OOC_ND,
      OOC_3A,
      OOC_3B,
      benchmark_n,
      UCL,
      dplyr::starts_with("S_chart_ARL1_rho_"),
      dplyr::starts_with("ARL1_rho_"),
      dplyr::everything()
    )
}
```

```{r d-ccssbu-s-d-selection-arl1-functions-v6}
  # ==========================================================
  # General helper functions
  # ==========================================================

  collapse_set <- function(x) {

    x <- sort(
      unique(x)
    )

    x <- x[
      !is.na(x)
    ]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return("")
    }

    paste(
      x,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  }

  values_tied <- function(
    x,
    target,
    tolerance = comparison_tolerance
  ) {

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(
        logical(0)
      )
    }

    if (
      length(target) != 1 ||
        is.na(target)
    ) {
      return(
        rep(
          FALSE,
          length(x)
        )
      )
    }

    if (is.infinite(target)) {
      return(
        is.infinite(x) &
          sign(x) == sign(target)
      )
    }

    is.finite(x) &
      abs(x - target) <=
        tolerance * max(
          1,
          abs(target)
        )
  }

  make_rho_label <- function(x) {

    x <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(x)
    )

    if (
      anyNA(x) ||
        any(!is.finite(x))
    ) {
      stop(
        "rho must contain only finite numeric values."
      )
    }

    x_formatted <- format(
      x,
      scientific = FALSE,
      trim = TRUE,
      digits = 15
    )

    x_formatted <- sub(
      pattern = "0+$",
      replacement = "",
      x = x_formatted
    )

    x_formatted <- sub(
      pattern = "\\.$",
      replacement = "",
      x = x_formatted
    )

    gsub(
      pattern = "\\.",
      replacement = "p",
      x = x_formatted
    )
  }

  round_numeric_columns <- function(tbl) {

    numeric_columns <- names(tbl)[
      vapply(
        tbl,
        is.numeric,
        FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
      )
    ]

    tbl |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::all_of(
            numeric_columns
          ),
          ~ round(
            .x,
            digits = round_digits
          )
        )
      )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Extract and validate information returned by d_ccssbu_s()
  # ==========================================================

  extract_event_statistics <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    event_statistics <- fit$event_statistics

    if (
      is.null(event_statistics) ||
        !is.data.frame(event_statistics) ||
        nrow(event_statistics) == 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No nonempty event_statistics table was returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    required_columns <- c(
      "Event",
      "Event_index",
      "S_t",
      "n_locations_observed"
    )

    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      required_columns,
      names(event_statistics)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The following required column(s) are missing from ",
          "event_statistics for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ": ",
          paste(
            missing_columns,
            collapse = ", "
          ),
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    tibble::as_tibble(
      event_statistics
    )
  }

  extract_normalized_data <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    normalized_data <- fit$normalized_data

    if (
      is.null(normalized_data) ||

      stop(
        paste0(
          "No nonempty normalized_data table was returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    required_columns <- c(
      "Event_index",
      "Normalized"
    )

    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      required_columns,
      names(normalized_data)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The following required column(s) are missing from ",
          "normalized_data for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ": ",
          paste(
            missing_columns,
            collapse = ", "
          ),

      )

    tibble::as_tibble(
      normalized_data
    )
  }

  extract_q <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type
  ) {

    q_value <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(fit$q)
    )

    if (
      length(q_value) != 1 ||
        is.na(q_value) ||
        !is.finite(q_value) ||
        q_value < 1
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "A valid q value was not returned by d_ccssbu_s() ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    q_integer <- as.integer(
      round(q_value)
    )

    if (
      abs(q_value - q_integer) >
        comparison_tolerance
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The q value returned by d_ccssbu_s() is not an ",
          "integer for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    q_integer
  }

  extract_stage3a_z <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type
  ) {

    normalized_data <- extract_normalized_data(
      fit = fit,
      residue_type = residue_type,
      d_value = 1
    )

    D_3A_event_index <- suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(
        fit$D_3A_event_index
      )
    )

    D_3A_event_index <- sort(
      unique(
        D_3A_event_index[
          !is.na(D_3A_event_index)
        ]
      )
    )

    if (length(D_3A_event_index) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No Stage 3A event indices were returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    stage3a_z <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$Event_index %in%
          D_3A_event_index
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$Normalized
      )

    stage3a_z <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(stage3a_z)
    )

    stage3a_z <- stage3a_z[
      !is.na(stage3a_z) &
        is.finite(stage3a_z)
    ]

    if (length(stage3a_z) < 2) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least two finite Stage 3A USL-normalized ",
          "observations are required for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    stage3a_z
  }
```
