```{r d-ccssbu-s-d-selection-arl1-functions-v6}
  # ==========================================================
  # Identify all-ND events
  # ==========================================================

  extract_all_nd_event_index <- function(
    fit,
    event_statistics,
    normalized_data,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    if ("all_ND_event" %in% names(event_statistics)) {

      all_nd_event_index <- event_statistics |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(.data$all_ND_event),
          .data$all_ND_event
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$Event_index
        )

    } else if ("ND_flag" %in% names(normalized_data)) {

      all_nd_event_index <- normalized_data |>
        dplyr::group_by(
          .data$Event_index
        ) |>
        dplyr::summarise(
          all_ND_event = all(
            .data$ND_flag,
            na.rm = FALSE
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(.data$all_ND_event),
          .data$all_ND_event
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$Event_index
        )

    } else {

      stop(
        paste0(
          "Neither all_ND_event in event_statistics nor ",
          "ND_flag in normalized_data was returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ". An all-ND event cannot be identified reliably."
        )
      )
    }

    sort(
      unique(
        suppressWarnings(
          as.integer(all_nd_event_index)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Conventional normal-reference one-sided S-chart ARL1
  # ==========================================================

  conventional_s_chart_arl1 <- function(
    n,
    rho,
    alpha
  ) {

    if (
      length(n) != 1 ||
        is.na(n) ||
        !is.finite(n) ||
        n < 2
    ) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    if (
      length(rho) != 1 ||
        is.na(rho) ||
        !is.finite(rho) ||
        rho <= 0
    ) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    if (
      length(alpha) != 1 ||
        is.na(alpha) ||
        !is.finite(alpha) ||
        alpha <= 0 ||
        alpha >= 1
    ) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    n <- as.integer(
      round(n)
    )

    degrees_of_freedom <- n - 1L

    chi_square_limit <- stats::qchisq(
      p = 1 - alpha,
      df = degrees_of_freedom
    )

    chi_square_threshold <-
      chi_square_limit / rho^2

    p1_s <- stats::pchisq(
      q = chi_square_threshold,
      df = degrees_of_freedom,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )

    if (is.na(p1_s)) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    if (p1_s <= 0) {
      return(
        Inf
      )
    }

    1 / p1_s
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Determine conventional S-chart benchmark subgroup size
  # ==========================================================

  get_benchmark_n <- function(
    residue_type,
    residue_position,
    event_statistics
  ) {

    if (is.null(benchmark_n)) {

      if (
        !"n_locations_observed" %in%
          names(event_statistics)
      ) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "The column n_locations_observed was not found ",
            "for residue ",
            residue_type,
            ". Provide benchmark_n explicitly."
          )
        )
      }

      observed_n <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          event_statistics$n_locations_observed
        )
      )

      observed_n <- observed_n[
        !is.na(observed_n) &
          is.finite(observed_n) &
          observed_n >= 2
      ]

      if (length(observed_n) == 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No finite subgroup sizes of at least 2 were found ",
            "for residue ",
            residue_type,
            ". Provide benchmark_n explicitly."
          )
        )
      }

      benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(
        round(
          stats::median(observed_n)
        )
      )

    } else if (
      !is.null(names(benchmark_n)) &&
        residue_type %in% names(benchmark_n)
    ) {

      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          benchmark_n[[residue_type]]
        )
      )

    } else if (length(benchmark_n) == 1) {

      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          benchmark_n[[1]]
        )
      )

    } else if (
      length(benchmark_n) ==
        length(residue_types)
    ) {

      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          benchmark_n[[residue_position]]
        )
      )

    } else {

      stop(
        paste0(
          "benchmark_n must be NULL, one number, a named ",
          "vector by residue type, or a vector having the ",
          "same length as residue_types."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      length(benchmark_n_i) != 1 ||
        is.na(benchmark_n_i) ||
        !is.finite(benchmark_n_i) ||
        benchmark_n_i < 2
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The conventional S-chart benchmark requires ",
          "benchmark_n >= 2 for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    benchmark_n_i
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Recommend d for one residue type
  # ==========================================================

  recommend_d_for_residue <- function(
    candidate_tbl
  ) {
    required_columns <- c(
  "Residue",
  "d",
  "q",
  "OOC_ND",
  "OOC_3A",
  "OOC_3B",
  "rho",
  "ARL1",
  "S_chart_ARL1",
  "s_Z",
  "sigma_Z"
)
    
    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      required_columns,
      names(candidate_tbl)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The recommendation input is missing column(s): ",
          paste(
            missing_columns,
            collapse = ", "
          )
        )
      )
    }

    if (nrow(candidate_tbl) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No candidate rows were supplied."
      )
    }

    residue_values <- unique(
      as.character(
        candidate_tbl$Residue
      )
    )

    residue_values <- residue_values[
      !is.na(residue_values) &
        nzchar(trimws(residue_values))
    ]

    if (length(residue_values) != 1) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "recommend_d_for_residue() requires exactly one ",
          "residue type."
        )
      )
    }

    residue_i <- residue_values[[1]]

    q_values <- unique(
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(candidate_tbl$q)
      )
    )

    q_values <- q_values[
      !is.na(q_values) &
        is.finite(q_values)
    ]

    if (length(q_values) != 1) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Exactly one finite q value is required for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    q_i <- as.integer(
      round(q_values[[1]])
    )

    candidate_values <- sort(
      unique(
        suppressWarnings(
          as.integer(candidate_tbl$d)
        )
      )
    )

    candidate_values <- candidate_values[
      !is.na(candidate_values)
    ]

    expected_candidates <- seq_len(
      q_i
    )

    if (!identical(
      candidate_values,
      expected_candidates
    )) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The candidate set for residue ",
          residue_i,
          " must be d = 1, 2, ..., q."
        )
      )
    }

    duplicate_grid_rows <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::count(
        .data$d,
        .data$rho,
        name = "n_rows"
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$n_rows != 1
      )

    if (nrow(duplicate_grid_rows) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least one residue-d-rho combination has ",
          "duplicate rows for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    for (d_i in candidate_values) {

      observed_rho_i <- candidate_tbl |>
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$d == d_i
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$rho
        )

      observed_rho_i <- sort(
        unique(
          suppressWarnings(
            as.numeric(observed_rho_i)
          )
        )
      )

      if (
        length(observed_rho_i) !=
          length(rho_grid) ||
          any(
            abs(
              observed_rho_i -
                rho_grid
            ) >
              comparison_tolerance
          )
      ) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Candidate d = ",
            d_i,
            " for residue ",
            residue_i,
            " does not contain the complete rho grid."
          )
        )
      }
    }

    candidate_identifier_check <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_OOC_ND = dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_ND,
          na.rm = FALSE
        ),
        n_OOC_3A = dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_3A,
          na.rm = FALSE
        ),
        n_OOC_3B = dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_3B,
          na.rm = FALSE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$n_OOC_ND > 1 |
          .data$n_OOC_3A > 1 |
          .data$n_OOC_3B > 1
      )

    if (nrow(candidate_identifier_check) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "OOC counts vary across rho for at least one d ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    candidate_metrics <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        R =
          .data$ARL1 /
            .data$S_chart_ARL1
      ) |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$Residue,
        .data$d,
        .data$q
      ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        OOC_ND =
          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_ND),
        OOC_3A =
          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3A),
        OOC_3B =
          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3B),

        all_R_valid = all(
          !is.na(.data$R) &
            .data$R > 0
        ),

        W = if (
          all(
            !is.na(.data$R) &
              .data$R > 0
          )
        ) {
          max(.data$R)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },

        G = if (
          all(
            !is.na(.data$R) &
              .data$R > 0
          )
        ) {
          exp(
            mean(
              log(.data$R)
            )
          )
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },

        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$d
      )

    if (
      any(
        !candidate_metrics$all_R_valid
      ) ||
        anyNA(candidate_metrics$W) ||
        anyNA(candidate_metrics$G)
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least one relative ARL curve is invalid for ",
          "residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 5 and 6. Construct D1, D2, and A
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    C_d <- sort(
      unique(
        candidate_metrics$d
      )
    )

    D1 <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$OOC_ND == 0
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()

    D2 <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$OOC_3A == 0
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()

    D12 <- sort(
      intersect(
        D1,
        D2
      )
    )

    if (length(D12) > 0) {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "D1_intersect_D2"

      A <- D12

    } else if (length(D1) > 0) {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "D1"

      A <- D1

    } else if (length(D2) > 0) {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "D2"

      A <- D2

    } else {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "C_d"

      A <- C_d
    }

    A <- sort(
      unique(A)
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 7. Construct U
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    metrics_A <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$d %in% A
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$d
      )

    U <- metrics_A |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$W <=
          1 + comparison_tolerance
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 8. Apply U or XO selection
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    tied_W_d <- integer(0)
    tied_G_d <- integer(0)

    minimum_W <- NA_real_
    minimum_G <- NA_real_

    if (length(U) > 0) {

      arl_curve_case <- "U"

      d_rec <- as.integer(
        max(U)
      )

      tied_W_d <- d_rec
      tied_G_d <- d_rec

      selection_rule <- paste0(
        "U case: maximum d in U according to Rule 3"
      )

    } else {

      arl_curve_case <- "XO"

      minimum_W <- min(
        metrics_A$W
      )

      tied_W_d <- metrics_A |>
        dplyr::filter(
          values_tied(
            .data$W,
            minimum_W
          )
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$d
        ) |>
        unique() |>
        sort()

      if (length(tied_W_d) == 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No candidate attained the minimum W value for ",
            "residue ",
            residue_i,
            "."
          )
        )
      }

      metrics_W_tie <- metrics_A |>
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$d %in%
            tied_W_d
        )

      minimum_G <- min(
        metrics_W_tie$G
      )

      tied_G_d <- metrics_W_tie |>
        dplyr::filter(
          values_tied(
            .data$G,
            minimum_G
          )
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$d
        ) |>
        unique() |>
        sort()

      if (length(tied_G_d) == 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No candidate attained the minimum G value among ",
            "the candidates tied on W for residue ",
            residue_i,
            "."
          )
        )
      }

      d_rec <- as.integer(
        max(tied_G_d)
      )

      selection_rule <- paste0(
        "XO case: minimum W over A; minimum G among ",
        "candidates tied on W; maximum d if a tie remains ",
        "according to Rule 3"
      )
    }

    selected_metrics <- metrics_A |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$d == d_rec
      )

    selected_W <- selected_metrics$W[[1]]
    selected_G <- selected_metrics$G[[1]]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Assign one of the eight decision cases
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    case_key <- paste(
      observed_behavior_case,
      arl_curve_case,
      sep = "|"
    )

    case_lookup <- c(
      "D1_intersect_D2|U" = "Case 1",
      "D1_intersect_D2|XO" = "Case 2",
      "D1|U" = "Case 3",
      "D1|XO" = "Case 4",
      "D2|U" = "Case 5",
      "D2|XO" = "Case 6",
      "C_d|U" = "Case 7",
      "C_d|XO" = "Case 8"
    )

    selected_case <- unname(
      case_lookup[
        case_key
      ]
    )

    if (
      length(selected_case) != 1 ||
        is.na(selected_case)
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The eight-case decision path could not be assigned ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    notes <- character(0)

    if (length(D1) == 0) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "D1 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
          "one all-ND event as OOC."
        )
      )
    }

    if (length(D2) == 0) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "D2 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
          "one nominal Stage 3A event as OOC."
        )
      )
    }

    if (length(U) == 0) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "U is empty: every candidate in A has at least one ",
          "rho value for which its d-CCSSBU-S ARL1 exceeds ",
          "the corresponding S-chart ARL1 benchmark."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      arl_curve_case == "XO" &&
        length(tied_W_d) > 1
    ) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "Candidate d values ",
          collapse_set(tied_W_d),
          " attained the same minimum W value."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      arl_curve_case == "XO" &&
        length(tied_G_d) > 1
    ) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "Candidate d values ",
          collapse_set(tied_G_d),
          " remained tied after comparing G. The largest ",
          "tied value of d was selected according to Rule 3."
        )
      )
    }

    if (arl_curve_case == "U") {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "The largest d in U was selected according to Rule 3 ",
          "because every candidate in U has an ARL1 curve that ",
          "remains below or touches the S-chart benchmark ",
          "throughout the complete rho grid."
        )
      )
    }

    recommendation_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      Residue = residue_i,
      recommended_d = d_rec,
      q = q_i,
      s_Z = dplyr::first(candidate_tbl$s_Z),
      sigma_Z = dplyr::first(candidate_tbl$sigma_Z),
      observed_behavior_case =        observed_behavior_case,
      arl_curve_case =        arl_curve_case,
      selected_case =        selected_case,
      selection_rule =        selection_rule,
      C_d_values =        collapse_set(C_d),
      D1_values =        collapse_set(D1),
      D2_values =        collapse_set(D2),
      A_values =        collapse_set(A),
      U_values =        collapse_set(U),
      W_tied_d_values =        collapse_set(tied_W_d),
      G_tied_d_values =        collapse_set(tied_G_d),
      minimum_W =        minimum_W,
      minimum_G_among_W_ties =        minimum_G,
      recommended_W =        selected_W,
      recommended_G =        selected_G,
      selection_path = paste(
        selected_case,
        observed_behavior_case,
        arl_curve_case,
        selection_rule,
        sep = " | "
      ),
      recommendation_notes = paste(
        notes,
        collapse = " | "
      )
    )

    candidate_metrics_output <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        in_C_d =
          .data$d %in% C_d,
        in_D1 =
          .data$d %in% D1,
        in_D2 =
          .data$d %in% D2,
        in_A =
          .data$d %in% A,
        in_U =
          .data$d %in% U,
        selected =
          .data$d == d_rec
      )

    list(
      recommendation =
        recommendation_tbl,
      candidate_metrics =
        candidate_metrics_output
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Fit all residue types and candidate d values
  # ==========================================================

  all_rows <- list()
  all_fit_objects <- list()
  all_candidate_information <- list()
  all_benchmark_models <- list()

  row_id <- 1L
  fit_id <- 1L

  for (rr in seq_along(residue_types)) {

    residue_type_i <- residue_types[[rr]]
    sheet_i <- sheets[[rr]]

    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
      message(
        "Processing residue type: ",
        residue_type_i,
        " | sheet: ",
        sheet_i
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1. Initial d = 1 fit to determine q
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fit_q <- d_ccssbu_s(
      file = file,
      equipment_label = equipment_label,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      sheet = sheet_i,
      d = 1,
      n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
      target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
      B = B,
      c_smooth = c_smooth,
      h_min = h_min,
      seed = seed + 1000L * rr + 1L,
      scale_eligibility_threshold =
        scale_eligibility_threshold,
      scale_distinct_digits =
        scale_distinct_digits,
      cluster_col = cluster_col,
      cluster_group_cols =
        cluster_group_cols,
      cluster_round_digits =
        cluster_round_digits,
      event_col = event_col,
      location_col = location_col,
      result_col = result_col,
      lod_col = lod_col,
      loq_col = loq_col,
      usl_col = usl_col,
      plot_chart = FALSE,
      save_outputs = FALSE,
      return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
      keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE
    )

    event_statistics_q <- extract_event_statistics(
      fit = fit_q,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      d_value = 1
    )

    q_residue <- extract_q(
      fit = fit_q,
      residue_type = residue_type_i
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2. Construct benchmark model once per residue
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    stage3a_z_i <- extract_stage3a_z(
      fit = fit_q,
      residue_type = residue_type_i
    )

    mu_0_i <- mean(
      stage3a_z_i
    )

    s_Z_i <- stats::sd(
      stage3a_z_i
    )

    if (
      is.na(mu_0_i) ||
        !is.finite(mu_0_i)
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The Stage 3A mean could not be calculated for ",
          "residue ",
          residue_type_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      is.na(s_Z_i) ||
        !is.finite(s_Z_i) ||
        s_Z_i < 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The Stage 3A empirical standard deviation could ",
          "not be calculated for residue ",
          residue_type_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    sigma_Z_i <- max(
      s_Z_i,
      h_min
    )

    if (!is.finite(sigma_Z_i) ||sigma_Z_i <= 0) {stop(paste0("sigma_Z must be positive for residue ",residue_type_i,  "."  ) ) }

    benchmark_n_i <- get_benchmark_n(
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      residue_position = rr,
      event_statistics =event_statistics_q)

    degrees_of_freedom_i <-     benchmark_n_i - 1L

    chi_square_limit_i <- stats::qchisq(p = 1 - alpha,df = degrees_of_freedom_i  )

    UCL_S_i <- sigma_Z_i * sqrt(chi_square_limit_i /degrees_of_freedom_i)

    sigma_1_i <- rho_grid * sigma_Z_i

    benchmark_curve_i <- tibble::tibble(
      rho = rho_grid,
      mu_0 = mu_0_i,
      s_Z = s_Z_i,
      sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
      sigma_1 = sigma_1_i,
      benchmark_n = benchmark_n_i,
      degrees_of_freedom =    degrees_of_freedom_i,
      chi_square_limit =    chi_square_limit_i,
      UCL_S = UCL_S_i,
      S_chart_ARL1 = vapply(
        rho_grid,
        conventional_s_chart_arl1,
        n = benchmark_n_i,
        alpha = alpha,
        FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
      )
    )

    if (
      anyNA(
        benchmark_curve_i$S_chart_ARL1
      )
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least one conventional S-chart ARL1 benchmark ",
          "could not be calculated for residue ",
          residue_type_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    all_benchmark_models[[residue_type_i]] <- list(
      Residue = residue_type_i,
      stage3a_z = stage3a_z_i,
      mu_0 = mu_0_i,
      s_Z = s_Z_i,
      sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
      h_min = h_min,
      benchmark_n = benchmark_n_i,
      degrees_of_freedom =    degrees_of_freedom_i,
      chi_square_limit =      chi_square_limit_i,
      UCL_S = UCL_S_i,
      rho_grid = rho_grid,
      sigma_1 = sigma_1_i,
      benchmark_table =   benchmark_curve_i
    )

    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
      message(
        "  q = ",
        q_residue,
        " | benchmark n = ",
        benchmark_n_i,
        " | mu_0 = ",
        signif(mu_0_i, 6),
        " | s_Z = ",
        signif(s_Z_i, 6),
        " | sigma_Z = ",
        signif(sigma_Z_i, 6),
        " | UCL_S = ",
        signif(UCL_S_i, 6)
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 1 and 3. Fit d = 1, 2, ..., q
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for (d_i in seq_len(q_residue)) {

      if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("  Fitting d = ", d_i," of ",  q_residue) }

      if (d_i == 1L) {fit_i <- fit_q} 
      else {fit_i <- d_ccssbu_s(
          file = file,
          equipment_label = equipment_label,
          residue_type = residue_type_i,
          sheet = sheet_i,
          d = d_i,
          n_stage3A_events =      n_stage3A_events,
          target_ARL0 =         target_ARL0,
          B = B,
          c_smooth =        c_smooth,
          h_min =         h_min,
          seed =    seed + 1000L * rr + d_i,
          scale_eligibility_threshold =    scale_eligibility_threshold,
          scale_distinct_digits =     scale_distinct_digits,
          cluster_col =    cluster_col,
          cluster_group_cols =  cluster_group_cols,
          cluster_round_digits =  cluster_round_digits,
          event_col =      event_col,
          location_col =  location_col,
          result_col =    result_col,
          lod_col =       lod_col,
          loq_col =        loq_col,
          usl_col =         usl_col,
          plot_chart = FALSE,
          save_outputs = FALSE,
          return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
          keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE )}

      event_statistics_i <- extract_event_statistics(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i, d_value = d_i )

      normalized_data_i <- extract_normalized_data(  fit = fit_i, residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i )

      CL_i <- extract_chart_limit(  fit = fit_i,  limit_type = "CL",  residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i   )

      UCL_i <- extract_chart_limit( fit = fit_i,limit_type = "UCL", residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i  )

      calibration_case_i <- extract_calibration_case( fit = fit_i,  residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i )

      n_cal_i <- extract_n_cal(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)

      bootstrap_scale_i <-extract_bootstrap_scale(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)

      n_bootstrap_i <- length(bootstrap_scale_i )

      if (n_bootstrap_i < 1) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No bootstrap scale statistics were available for ",
            "residue ",
            residue_type_i,
            " and d = ",
            d_i,
            "."
          )
        )
      }

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Observed OOC counts for Rules 1 and 2
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      all_nd_event_index_i <-    extract_all_nd_event_index(
          fit = fit_i,
          event_statistics =  event_statistics_i,
          normalized_data =  normalized_data_i,
          residue_type =  residue_type_i,
          d_value =   d_i )

      signal_i <- event_statistics_i$S_t >UCL_i

      signal_i[is.na(signal_i)] <- FALSE

      OOC_ND_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          Signal_d_selection_S =
            signal_i
        ) |>
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$Event_index %in%
            all_nd_event_index_i,
          .data$Signal_d_selection_S
        )

      OOC_3A_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(Signal_d_selection_S =signal_i) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%  fit_i$D_3A_event_index, .data$Signal_d_selection_S)

      OOC_3B_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(Signal_d_selection_S =signal_i) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%fit_i$monitoring_event_index,.data$Signal_d_selection_S)

      OOC_ND_i <- nrow(  OOC_ND_tbl_i )

      OOC_3A_i <- validate_ooc_count(
        value = fit_i$n_stage3A_ooc,
        value_name = "n_stage3A_ooc",
        residue_type = residue_type_i,
        d_value = d_i
      )

      OOC_3B_i <- validate_ooc_count(
        value = fit_i$n_stage3B_ooc,
        value_name = "n_stage3B_ooc",
        residue_type = residue_type_i,
        d_value = d_i
      )

      if (OOC_3A_i != nrow(OOC_3A_tbl_i)) {stop( paste0( "The recalculated Stage 3A OOC count does not ",
            "equal fit$n_stage3A_ooc for residue ",  residue_type_i," and d = ",  d_i,".")) }

      if (OOC_3B_i != nrow(OOC_3B_tbl_i)) {stop(paste0("The recalculated Stage 3B OOC count does not ","equal fit$n_stage3B_ooc for residue ", residue_type_i, " and d = ",d_i,  "."))}

      OOC_ND_events_i <- if ( OOC_ND_i > 0) { paste(OOC_ND_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", " ) } else {""}

      OOC_3A_events_i <- if ( OOC_3A_i > 0) { paste(OOC_3A_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", ")} else {""}

      OOC_3B_events_i <- if (OOC_3B_i > 0) {paste(OOC_3B_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", ")} else {""}

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 3. Candidate-specific ARL1 curves
      # S_b^{*,rho}(d) = rho S_b^*(d)
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      n_signals_i <- vapply(rho_grid,FUN = function(rho_value) {sum(rho_value *bootstrap_scale_i >UCL_i,na.rm = TRUE) }, FUN.VALUE = integer(1))

      p1_i <- n_signals_i / n_bootstrap_i

      ARL1_uncensored_i <- ifelse(p1_i > 0,  1 / p1_i,  Inf )

      expected_truncated_run_length_i <-ifelse( p1_i > 0, (1 -(1 - p1_i)^T_max) / p1_i,T_max )

      ARL1_exceeds_T_max_i <- !is.finite(ARL1_uncensored_i) | ARL1_uncensored_i > T_max

      candidate_shift_tbl_i <-  tibble::tibble(
          rho = rho_grid,
          n_bootstrap =   n_bootstrap_i,
          n_signals =   n_signals_i,
          p1 =  p1_i,
          ARL1 =  ARL1_uncensored_i,
          expected_truncated_run_length =  expected_truncated_run_length_i,
          ARL1_exceeds_T_max =  ARL1_exceeds_T_max_i
        )

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 4. Add conventional S-chart benchmark
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      candidate_rows_i <-
        candidate_shift_tbl_i |>
        dplyr::left_join(
          benchmark_curve_i,
          by = "rho"
        ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          Equipment =            equipment_label,
          Residue =            residue_type_i,
          sheet =            as.character(sheet_i),
          d =            as.integer(d_i),
          q =            as.integer(q_residue),
          calibration_case =            calibration_case_i,
          nCal =            as.integer(n_cal_i),
          OOC_ND =            as.integer(OOC_ND_i),
          OOC_3A =            as.integer(OOC_3A_i),
          OOC_3B =            as.integer(OOC_3B_i),
          OOC_ND_events =            OOC_ND_events_i,
          OOC_3A_events =            OOC_3A_events_i,
          OOC_3B_events =            OOC_3B_events_i,
          CL =            CL_i,
          UCL =            UCL_i,
          target_ARL0 =            target_ARL0,
          alpha =            alpha,
          B =            B,
          T_max =            T_max,
          .before = 1 ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(relative_ARL_ratio =  .data$ARL1 /.data$S_chart_ARL1)

      all_rows[[row_id]] <-  candidate_rows_i

      fit_object_name <- paste0(residue_type_i, "_d",  d_i)

      all_fit_objects[[fit_id]] <-        fit_i

      names(all_fit_objects)[[fit_id]] <-        fit_object_name

      all_candidate_information[[fit_id]] <-list(
          Residue =            residue_type_i,
          d =            as.integer(d_i),
          q =            as.integer(q_residue),
          calibration_case =            calibration_case_i,
          nCal =            as.integer(n_cal_i),
          calibration_data =            fit_i$calibration_data,
          calibration_status =            fit_i$cluster_calibration_status,
          CL =            CL_i,
          UCL =            UCL_i,
          OOC_ND =            as.integer(OOC_ND_i),
          OOC_3A =            as.integer(OOC_3A_i),
          OOC_3B =            as.integer(OOC_3B_i),
          all_ND_event_index =            all_nd_event_index_i,
          benchmark_n =            as.integer(benchmark_n_i),
          mu_0 =            mu_0_i,
          s_Z =            s_Z_i,
          sigma_Z =            sigma_Z_i,
          rho_grid =            rho_grid,
          sigma_1 =            sigma_1_i,
          degrees_of_freedom =            degrees_of_freedom_i,
          chi_square_limit =            chi_square_limit_i,
          UCL_S =            UCL_S_i,
          bootstrap_scale_statistics =            bootstrap_scale_i,
          event_statistics =            event_statistics_i)

      names(all_candidate_information)[[fit_id]] <- fit_object_name

      row_id <- row_id + 1L
      fit_id <- fit_id + 1L
    }
  }

  if (length(all_rows) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No candidate-specific ARL1 results were generated."
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Combine candidate-specific ARL1 results
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_long_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    all_rows
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      ),
      .data$d,
      .data$rho
    )

  arl1_split <- split(
    arl1_long_tbl,
    factor(
      arl1_long_tbl$Residue,
      levels = residue_types
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  )

  recommendation_outputs <- lapply(
    arl1_split,
    recommend_d_for_residue
  )

  recommendation_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      recommendation_outputs,
      function(x) {
        x$recommendation
      }
    )
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      )
    )

  candidate_metrics_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      recommendation_outputs,
      function(x) {
        x$candidate_metrics
      }
    )
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      ),
      .data$d
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # Add selection information to long-format ARL1 table
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_long_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      candidate_metrics_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Residue,
          .data$d,
          .data$W,
          .data$G,
          .data$in_C_d,
          .data$in_D1,
          .data$in_D2,
          .data$in_A,
          .data$in_U,
          .data$selected), by = c( "Residue","d" ) ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      recommendation_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Residue,
          .data$recommended_d,
          .data$observed_behavior_case,
          .data$arl_curve_case,
          .data$selected_case,
          .data$selection_rule,
          .data$A_values,
          .data$U_values,
          .data$selection_path,
          .data$recommendation_notes
        ),
      by = "Residue") |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      ),
      .data$d,
      .data$rho
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct wide ARL1 table internally
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_wide_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(rho_label = make_rho_label(.data$rho)) |>
    dplyr::select(
      .data$Residue,
      .data$d,
      .data$q,
      .data$calibration_case,
      .data$nCal,
      .data$OOC_ND,
      .data$OOC_3A,
      .data$OOC_3B,
      .data$benchmark_n,
      .data$mu_0,
      .data$s_Z,
      .data$sigma_Z,
      .data$degrees_of_freedom,
      .data$chi_square_limit,
      .data$UCL_S,
      .data$CL,
      .data$UCL,
      .data$W,
      .data$G,
      .data$in_C_d,
      .data$in_D1,
      .data$in_D2,
      .data$in_A,
      .data$in_U,
      .data$selected,
      .data$recommended_d,
      .data$observed_behavior_case,
      .data$arl_curve_case,
      .data$selected_case,
      .data$selection_rule,
      .data$A_values,
      .data$U_values,
      .data$selection_path,
      .data$recommendation_notes,
      .data$rho_label,
      .data$sigma_1,
      .data$S_chart_ARL1,
      .data$ARL1,
      .data$relative_ARL_ratio) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(
        "Residue",
        "d",
        "q",
        "calibration_case",
        "nCal",
        "OOC_ND",
        "OOC_3A",
        "OOC_3B",
        "benchmark_n",
        "mu_0",
        "s_Z",
        "sigma_Z",
        "degrees_of_freedom",
        "chi_square_limit",
        "UCL_S",
        "CL",
        "UCL",
        "W",
        "G",
        "in_C_d",
        "in_D1",
        "in_D2",
        "in_A",
        "in_U",
        "selected",
        "recommended_d",
        "observed_behavior_case",
        "arl_curve_case",
        "selected_case",
        "selection_rule",
        "A_values",
        "U_values",
        "selection_path",
        "recommendation_notes"),
      names_from =        .data$rho_label,
      values_from = c(.data$sigma_1,.data$S_chart_ARL1, .data$ARL1, .data$relative_ARL_ratio),
      names_glue ="{.value}_rho_{rho_label}",
      names_sort =FALSE) |>
    dplyr::arrange( match(.data$Residue,  residue_types), .data$d )

  # ==========================================================
  # Extract recommended d values
  # ==========================================================

  recommended_d_named <- stats::setNames(as.integer( recommendation_tbl$recommended_d), recommendation_tbl$Residue)

  DAR_d <- if ( "DAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)  ) {
    as.integer(      recommended_d_named[["DAR"]]    )  } else {    NA_integer_  }

  CAR_d <- if ("CAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)) {as.integer(recommended_d_named[["CAR"]])
  } else {    NA_integer_  }

  Mic_d <- if ("Mic" %in% names(recommended_d_named)) { as.integer(recommended_d_named[["Mic"]])
  } else {    NA_integer_  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct rounded display versions
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_long_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(  arl1_long_tbl  )

  arl1_wide_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(  arl1_wide_tbl  )

  recommendation_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(    recommendation_tbl  )

  candidate_metrics_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(    candidate_metrics_tbl  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Completion messages
  # ==========================================================

  if (isTRUE(verbose)) {

    message(
      "Completed d-CCSSBU-S d selection."
    )

    for (
      ii in seq_len(
        nrow(recommendation_tbl)
      )
    ) {
      message(
        "  ",
        recommendation_tbl$Residue[[ii]],
        ": recommended d = ",
        recommendation_tbl$recommended_d[[ii]],
        " | ",
        recommendation_tbl$selected_case[[ii]],
        " | ",
        recommendation_tbl$arl_curve_case[[ii]]
      )
    }
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Return all results
  # ==========================================================

  result <- list(

    # Recommended d values
    recommendations =      recommendation_tbl,
    recommendations_display =      recommendation_display_tbl,
    recommended_d =      recommended_d_named,
    DAR_d =      DAR_d,
    CAR_d =      CAR_d,
    Mic_d =      Mic_d,

    # Candidate-level selection metrics
    candidate_metrics =      candidate_metrics_tbl,
    candidate_metrics_display =      candidate_metrics_display_tbl,

    # ARL1 results
    arl1_raw =      arl1_long_tbl,
    arl1_long =      arl1_long_tbl,
    arl1_long_display =      arl1_long_display_tbl,
    arl1_wide =      arl1_wide_tbl,
    arl1_wide_display =      arl1_wide_display_tbl,

    # Benchmark models
    benchmark_models =      all_benchmark_models,

    # Full fitted chart objects
    fit_objects =      all_fit_objects,

    # Detailed candidate information
    candidate_information =      all_candidate_information,

    # Settings
    benchmark_settings = list(
      target_ARL0 =        target_ARL0,
      alpha =        alpha,
      rho_grid =        rho_grid,
      benchmark_n =        benchmark_n,
      h_min =        h_min,
      T_max =        T_max
    ),

    settings = list(
      equipment_label =        equipment_label,
      residue_types =        residue_types,
      sheets =        sheets,
      n_stage3A_events =        n_stage3A_events,
      target_ARL0 =        target_ARL0,
      alpha =        alpha,
      B =        B,
      c_smooth =        c_smooth,
      h_min =        h_min,
      seed =        seed,
      scale_eligibility_threshold =        scale_eligibility_threshold,
      scale_distinct_digits =        scale_distinct_digits,
      cluster_col =        cluster_col,
      cluster_group_cols =        cluster_group_cols,
      cluster_round_digits =        cluster_round_digits,
      rho_grid =        rho_grid,
      T_max =        T_max,
      benchmark_n =        benchmark_n,
      comparison_tolerance =        comparison_tolerance,
      round_digits =        round_digits
    ),

    call =
      match.call()
  )

  class(result) <- c(
    "d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1",
    "list"
  )

  return(result)
}


render_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = "d-CCSSBU-S ARL1 simulation results.",
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7
) {

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

  } else {

    tbl %>%
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )
  }
}

render_d_ccssbu_s_recommendation_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = "Recommended d values for the d-CCSSBU-S chart.",
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7,
  show_notes = FALSE
) {

  if (is.null(tbl)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "tbl is NULL. Available outputs are typically ",
        "result$recommendations or ",
        "result$recommendations_display."
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop(
      "tbl must be a data frame."
    )
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop(
      "tbl contains no rows."
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Auto-map old and new output names
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  if (!"recommended_W" %in% names(tbl)) {

    if ("W" %in% names(tbl)) {
      tbl$recommended_W <- tbl$W
    }
  }

  if (!"recommended_G" %in% names(tbl)) {

    if ("G" %in% names(tbl)) {
      tbl$recommended_G <- tbl$G
    }
  }
required_columns <- c(
  "Residue",
  "recommended_d",
  "q",
  "s_Z",
  "sigma_Z",
  "observed_behavior_case",
  "arl_curve_case",
  "selected_case",
  "selection_rule",
  "A_values",
  "U_values",
  "recommended_W",
  "recommended_G"
)

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing column(s): ",
        paste(
          missing_columns,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "\n\nAvailable columns:\n",
        paste(
          names(tbl),
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }

  if (!"recommendation_notes" %in% names(tbl)) {
    tbl$recommendation_notes <- ""
  }

  escape_latex_text <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)

    x[is.na(x)] <- ""

    placeholder <- "BACKSLASHPLACEHOLDER"

    x <- gsub("\\\\", placeholder, x)

    x <- gsub(
      "([#$%&_{}])",
      "\\\\\\1",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub(
      "~",
      "\\\\textasciitilde{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub("\\^","\\\\textasciicircum{}",  x,  perl = TRUE  )

    x <- gsub(
      placeholder,
      "\\\\textbackslash{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x
  }

  observed_case_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D1_intersect_D2" ~ "D1 ∩ D2",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D1" ~ "D1",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D2" ~ "D2",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "C_d" ~ "{1,...,q}",
    TRUE ~ tbl$observed_behavior_case
  )
  display_rule <- dplyr::case_when(
     tbl$arl_curve_case == "U" ~    "max d in U (Rule 3)",

     tbl$arl_curve_case == "XO" ~    "min W; min G; max d if tied (Rule 3)",

     TRUE ~    as.character(tbl$selection_rule)
   )

tbl_display <- tbl %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Residue = as.character(Residue),

    `Rec. d` = recommended_d,

    q = q,

    `sZ/sigZ` = paste0( formatC(s_Z, format = "f", digits = 4), " / ",formatC(sigma_Z, format = "f", digits = 4)),

    Case = as.character(selected_case),

    Behavior = observed_case_label,

    ARL1 = as.character(arl_curve_case),

    A = A_values,

    U = U_values,

    `W(d)` = recommended_W,

    `G(d)` = recommended_G,

    Rule = display_rule

  )

  notes_tbl <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue = as.character(Residue),
      Note = as.character(recommendation_notes)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Note),
      nzchar(trimws(Note))
    )

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label,
        escape = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

    cat(as.character(table_output), "\n")

    if (
      isTRUE(show_notes) &&
      nrow(notes_tbl) > 0
    ) {

      cat("\\vspace{1mm}\n")
      cat("\\begin{minipage}{0.96\\textwidth}\n")
      cat("\\footnotesize\n")
      cat("\\noindent\\textit{Notes.}\n")
      cat("\\begin{description}\n")

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(notes_tbl))) {

        cat(
          paste0(
            "\\item[\\textit{",
            escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Residue[i]),
            ":}] ",
            escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Note[i]),
            "\n"
          )
        )
      }

      cat("\\end{description}\n")
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
    }

  } else {

    table_output <- tbl_display %>%
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        escape = TRUE
      ) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover",
          "responsive"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )

    cat(as.character(table_output), "\n")
  }

  invisible(tbl_display)
}
```

```{r plot-d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

plot_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_curves <- function(
  tbl,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  output_file = NULL,
  residue_order = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  width = 9,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  y_log10 = TRUE,
  show_points = TRUE,
  base_size = 11
) {

  required_packages <- c(
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork"
  )

  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(
      required_packages,
      requireNamespace,
      quietly = TRUE,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_packages,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop("tbl must be a data frame.")
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop("tbl contains no rows.")
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "rho",
    "ARL1",
    "S_chart_ARL1"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(equipment_label) != 1 ||
    is.na(equipment_label) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(equipment_label))
  ) {
    stop(
      "equipment_label must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(width) != 1 ||
    is.na(width) ||
    !is.finite(width) ||
    width <= 0
  ) {
    stop("width must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  if (
    length(height) != 1 ||
    is.na(height) ||
    !is.finite(height) ||
    height <= 0
  ) {
    stop("height must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  if (
    length(dpi) != 1 ||
    is.na(dpi) ||
    !is.finite(dpi) ||
    dpi <= 0
  ) {
    stop("dpi must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  residue_order <- unique(
    as.character(residue_order)
  )

  available_residues <- unique(
    as.character(tbl$Residue)
  )

  missing_residues <- setdiff(
    residue_order,
    available_residues
  )

  if (length(missing_residues) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following requested residue type(s) are absent from tbl: ",
      paste(
        missing_residues,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  plot_data <- tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue = as.character(Residue),
      d = as.integer(d),
      rho = as.numeric(rho),
      ARL1 = as.numeric(ARL1),
      S_chart_ARL1 = as.numeric(S_chart_ARL1)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Residue %in% residue_order
    )

  invalid_rows <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(d) |
      is.na(rho) |
      !is.finite(rho) |
      rho <= 0 |
      is.na(ARL1) |
      ARL1 <= 0 |
      is.na(S_chart_ARL1) |
      S_chart_ARL1 <= 0
    )

  if (nrow(invalid_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The plotting data contain missing, nonpositive, or ",
        "invalid values of d, rho, ARL1, or S_chart_ARL1."
      )
    )
  }

  duplicate_rows <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Residue,
      d,
      rho,
      name = "n_rows"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_rows > 1
    )

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Multiple rows were found for at least one ",
        "Residue, d, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  benchmark_check <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Residue,
      rho
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_benchmark_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(S_chart_ARL1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_benchmark_values > 1
    )

  if (nrow(benchmark_check) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The conventional S-chart ARL1 benchmark varies ",
        "across d for at least one Residue and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  nonfinite_rows <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.finite(ARL1) |
      !is.finite(S_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(nonfinite_rows) > 0) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        nrow(nonfinite_rows),
        " row(s) with infinite ARL1 values were omitted ",
        "because infinite values cannot be plotted."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(ARL1),
      is.finite(S_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No finite ARL1 values remain for plotting."
    )
  }

  rho_breaks <- sort(
    unique(plot_data$rho)
  )

  make_residue_plot <- function(
    residue_name
  ) {

    residue_data <- plot_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Residue == residue_name
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        d,
        rho
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        d_label = factor(
          paste0("d = ", d),
          levels = paste0(
            "d = ",
            sort(unique(d))
          )
        )
      )

    if (nrow(residue_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No finite plotting data were found for residue ",
        residue_name,
        "."
      )
    }

    benchmark_data <- residue_data %>%
      dplyr::select(
        rho,
        S_chart_ARL1
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct() %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        rho
      )

    residue_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = residue_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = ARL1,
          color = d_label,
          group = d_label
        ),
        linewidth = 0.85,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

    if (isTRUE(show_points)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
          data = residue_data,
          mapping = ggplot2::aes(
            x = rho,
            y = ARL1,
            color = d_label,
            group = d_label
          ),
          size = 1.8,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
    }

    residue_plot <- residue_plot +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = S_chart_ARL1,
          linetype = "S-chart ARL1 benchmark"
        ),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1.3,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = S_chart_ARL1
        ),
        color = "black",
        shape = 18,
        size = 2.7,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = rho_breaks,
        labels = formatC(
          rho_breaks,
          format = "f",
          digits = 2
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
          "S-chart ARL1 benchmark" = "longdash"
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(
          residue_name,
          " ARL1 curves"
        ),
        x = expression(
          "Multiplicative variability ratio, " * rho
        ),
        y = expression(ARL[1]),
        color = "d-CCSSBU-S candidate"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(
        base_size = base_size
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          hjust = 0
        ),
        panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold"
        )
      )

    if (isTRUE(y_log10)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::scale_y_log10()
    }

    residue_plot
  }

  residue_plots <- lapply(
    residue_order,
    make_residue_plot
  )

  names(residue_plots) <- residue_order

  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    residue_plots,
    ncol = 1,
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(
        "d-CCSSBU-S and conventional S-chart ARL1 curves for ",
        equipment_label
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
       "Candidate curves versus the conventional ",
        "S-chart ARL1 benchmark curve."
      ),
      theme = ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = base_size + 3,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = base_size,
          hjust = 0.5
        )
      )
    ) &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  if (is.null(output_file)) {

    equipment_file_name <- tolower(
      trimws(equipment_label)
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "[^a-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "-",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "^-+|-+$",
      replacement = "",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    output_file <- paste0(
      "d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-",
      equipment_file_name,
      ".png"
    )
  }

  if (
    length(output_file) != 1 ||
    is.na(output_file) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(output_file))
  ) {
    stop(
      "output_file must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (!grepl(
  pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg)$",
  x = output_file,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)) {
  output_file <- paste0(
    output_file,
    ".png"
  )
  }
  

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_file,
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )

  message(
    "The ARL1 curve figure was saved to: ",
    normalizePath(
      output_file,
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = FALSE
    )
  )

  invisible(
    list(
      plot = combined_plot,
      panels = residue_plots,
      output_file = output_file,
      plotting_data = plot_data
    )
  )
}
```

@fig-d-selection-curve-a-s visualizes the corresponding ARL$_1$ curves for the d-CCSSBU-S chart for Equipment A. Three patterns may be observed. First, for CAR, the conventional $S$ chart consistently exhibits smaller ARL$_1$ values than the d-CCSSBU-S chart throughout the multiplicative variability-ratio range of $\rho$, indicating greater sensitivity to variability shifts. Second, for DAR, the ARL$_1$ curve for $d=1$ intersects the benchmark $S$-chart ARL$_1$ curve. At smaller values of $\rho$, the d-CCSSBU-S chart exhibits smaller ARL$_1$ values than the benchmark $S$ chart, whereas at larger values of $\rho$, the benchmark $S$ chart exhibits smaller ARL$_1$ values. This behavior is expected for the same reason discussed for the d-CCSSBU-L chart ARL$_1$ curves.  Again notably, the reverse pattern was not observed; when the benchmark $S$ chart exhibited smaller ARL$_1$ values at the initial value of $\rho$, it continued to exhibit smaller ARL$_1$ values throughout the evaluated range of $\rho$. Third, the admissible DAR candidates exhibit different ARL$_1$ profiles, with the $d=1$ candidate visually producing the lowest ARL$_1$ curve among the admissible candidates. This visual observation is consistent with the final recommendation, although the formal selection was determined according to Rule 3 rather than by direct comparison of raw ARL$_1$ values.

Table \ref{tab:d-ccssbu-s-recommendation-equipment-b}  recommends $d=13$ for DAR and $d=1$ for CAR and Mic of Equipment B following Step 8 in the section of d selection (see the long performance table in [@Yang2026dccssbu] for details). The `Rule` and `Case` columns indicate that the DAR recommendation was obtained under Case 4, whereas the CAR and Mic recommendations were obtained under Case 2. For DAR, no candidate value of $d$ avoided a Stage 3A OOC signal; therefore, $\mathcal{D}_2=\varnothing$, and the operationally admissible set was constructed as $\mathcal{A}=\mathcal{D}_1$. Event 10 was classified as OOC for every value of $d$, indicating that this signal persisted across the candidate calibration structures and could not be eliminated through selection of $d$. Accordingly, the DAR recommendation followed Case 4. This persistent Stage 3A signal should be investigated through the applicable pharmaceutical quality system. A formal root-cause investigation is beyond the scope of the present statistical-methodology study.

@fig-d-selection-curve-b-s visualizes the corresponding ARL$_1$ curves for the d-CCSSBU-S chart for Equipment B. Two observations may be made. First, for DAR, CAR, and Mic, the ARL$_1$ curves of one or more d-CCSSBU-S candidates intersect the benchmark $S$-chart ARL$_1$ curve. At smaller values of $\rho$, some d-CCSSBU-S candidates exhibit smaller ARL$_1$ values than the benchmark $S$ chart, whereas at larger values of $\rho$, the benchmark $S$ chart exhibits smaller ARL$_1$ values. Similar to the Equipment A DAR results, this behavior is expected. Second, unlike the ARL$_1$ curves for Equipment A, the DAR and CAR candidates of Equipment B exhibit more complex and overlapping ARL$_1$ profiles. The preferred value of $d$ can no longer be identified reliably through visual inspection of the ARL$_1$ curves alone. This observation demonstrates the importance of the proposed Rule 1-Rule 3 d-selection framework, which provides a reproducible and objective method for selecting the final recommended value of $d$.

```{r s-curve-d-selection-b}
knitr::include_graphics("d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-equipment-b.jpeg")


```

**Performance of d-CCSSBU Charts vs $\bar X$-$S$ Charts.**  Taken together, @fig-d-selection-curve-a-l, @fig-d-selection-curve-b-l, @fig-d-selection-curve-a-s, and @fig-d-selection-curve-b-s illustrate three general ARL$_1$ performance patterns: 

- The d-CCSSBU charts may exhibit smaller ARL$_1$ values than the corresponding conventional benchmark charts throughout the evaluated shift range, as observed for the DAR location-chart results in Table\ref{tab:d-ccssbu-l-recommendation-equipment-a} and Table \ref{tab:d-ccssbu-l-recommendation-equipment-b}.

- The conventional benchmark charts may exhibit smaller ARL$_1$ values than the corresponding d-CCSSBU charts throughout the evaluated shift range, as observed for the CAR d-CCSSBU-S chart of Equipment A. 

- The ARL$_1$ curves may intersect. In such cases, the d-CCSSBU chart exhibits smaller ARL$_1$ values at smaller values of $\rho$, whereas the conventional $\bar X$ or $S$ chart exhibits smaller ARL$_1$ values at larger values of $\rho$. The reverse pattern was not observed. When a conventional $\bar X$ or $S$ chart exhibited smaller ARL$_1$ values than a d-CCSSBU candidate at the initial value of $\rho$, the conventional chart continued to exhibit smaller ARL$_1$ values throughout the evaluated range of $\rho$. 

Consequently, neither the d-CCSSBU charts nor the conventional benchmark charts exhibited uniform ARL$_1$ superiority across all datasets and shift magnitudes.

## d-CCSSBU Charts for Recommended $d$

The d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts for DAR are presented using the recommended values of $d$ for Equipment A (representing Stage 3A) and Equipment B (representing Stage 3B). Similar to the conventional $\bar{X}$-chart and $S$-chart pair, the d-CCSSBU-L chart monitors process location, whereas the d-CCSSBU-S chart monitors within-event variability. Together, the two charts provide complementary assessments of multicluster process stability.

### d-CCSSBU Charts for DAR of Equipment A and B

Figure \ref{fig:d-ccssbu-dar-equipment-ab} presents the d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts for DAR using the recommended values of $d$. For Equipment A, no OOC signals were observed on either the d-CCSSBU-L or d-CCSSBU-S chart, indicating stable process location and variability. For Equipment B, no OOC signals were observed on the d-CCSSBU-L chart, indicating stable process location performance. On the d-CCSSBU-S chart, Event 10 was identified as OOC. Inspection of the corresponding DAR observations (15.93, 0.11, 0.11, 15.93, and 32.95) shows substantial within-event variability, resulting in a large MAD value.

### d-CCSSBU Charts for CAR of Equipment A and B

Figure \ref{fig:d-ccssbu-car-equipment-ab} presents the d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts for CAR using the recommended values of $d$. For Equipment A, no OOC signals were observed on either the d-CCSSBU-L or d-CCSSBU-S chart, indicating stable process location and within-event variability.

For Equipment B, Event 19 was identified as OOC on the d-CCSSBU-L chart but not on the d-CCSSBU-S chart. The corresponding CAR observations were 35.49, 31.99, and 24.80, yielding a median value of 31.99 that was substantially higher than those of the surrounding events [see @Yang2026dccssbu for detailed data]. In contrast, the within-event variability remained relatively small, resulting in an in-control d-CCSSBU-S statistic. Consequently, Event 19 was detected as a location shift rather than a scale shift.

Equipment B contains CAR data from both the original cleaning process and its improved cleaning process using a new cleaning agent. By treating the two cleaning processes as separate clusters, the d-CCSSBU framework enables their performance to be evaluated within a common monitoring system. The resulting charts show that the improved cleaning process remains comparable to the original process and can be monitored using common control limits. This example illustrates that multicluster SPC can be used not only for stability monitoring but also for comparing related cleaning processes while accounting for their inherent differences.
