## Poisson u Chart Illustration for Mic Data

```{r poisson-u-chart-prepare-data}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

prepare_mic_data <- function(file,
                             equipment_label = "Equipment",
                             sheet = "Mic",
                             event_col = "Event",
                             location_col = "Location",
                             result_col = "Result",
                             usl_col = "USL") {

  required_pkgs <- c(
    "readxl",
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "stringr",
    "tibble",
    "readr",
    "knitr",
    "kableExtra"
  )

  missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[
    !(required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
  ]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  extract_event_number <- function(x) {

    x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))

    x_num_direct <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(x_chr)
    )

    x_num_extracted <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        stringr::str_extract(
          x_chr,
          "\\d+$"
        )
      )
    )

    dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(x_num_direct) ~ x_num_direct,
      !is.na(x_num_extracted) ~ x_num_extracted,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  }

  all_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

  if (!(sheet %in% all_sheets)) {
    stop(
      "Requested sheet was not found: ",
      sheet,
      ". Available sheets: ",
      paste(all_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  dat_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    path = file,
    sheet = sheet
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(
      ~ stringr::str_trim(.x)
    )

  result_col_actual <- result_col

  if (!(result_col_actual %in% names(dat_raw)) &&
      sheet %in% names(dat_raw)) {
    result_col_actual <- sheet
  }

  required_cols <- c(
    event_col,
    location_col,
    result_col_actual,
    usl_col
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required_cols,
    names(dat_raw)
  )

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Sheet ",
      sheet,
      " is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  mic_data <- dat_raw %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Equipment = equipment_label,
      Event = extract_event_number(.data[[event_col]]),
      Location = as.character(.data[[location_col]]),
      Result_chr = trimws(as.character(.data[[result_col_actual]])),
      Count_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Result_chr)),
      USL_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[usl_col]]))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Event),
      !is.na(Count_raw),
      is.finite(Count_raw),
      Count_raw >= 0,
      !is.na(USL_raw),
      is.finite(USL_raw),
      USL_raw > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Count = round(Count_raw),
      USL = USL_raw,
      Non_integer_flag = abs(Count_raw - Count) > 1e-8
    )

  if (nrow(mic_data) == 0) {
    stop("No usable Mic count observations were found.")
  }

  if (any(mic_data$Non_integer_flag, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    warning(
      "Some Mic results were non-integer values. They were rounded to the nearest integer for Poisson analysis."
    )
  }

  usl_values <- unique(
    mic_data$USL[
      is.finite(mic_data$USL)
    ]
  )

  if (length(usl_values) != 1) {
    stop(
      "Mic data should have a unique USL. Current number of unique USL values = ",
      length(usl_values),
      "."
    )
  }

  event_levels <- mic_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Event) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Event_index = dplyr::row_number()
    )

  mic_data <- mic_data %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      event_levels,
      by = "Event"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      Event_index,
      Location
    )

  mic_data
}
```

```{r poisson-u-chart-gof}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

poisson_gof_test <- function(counts,
                             gof_alpha = 0.05,
                             n_bootstrap = 5000,
                             seed = 123,
                             tail_probability = 0.999) {

  counts <- counts[
    !is.na(counts) &
      is.finite(counts) &
      counts >= 0
  ]

  counts <- round(counts)

  n <- length(counts)

  if (n < 2) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        n = n,
        lambda_hat = ifelse(n > 0, mean(counts), NA_real_),
        mean_count = ifelse(n > 0, mean(counts), NA_real_),
        var_count = NA_real_,
        chi_square_statistic = NA_real_,
        asymptotic_df = NA_real_,
        asymptotic_p_value = NA_real_,
        bootstrap_p_value = NA_real_,
        GOF_pass = NA,
        expected_min = NA_real_,
        expected_percent_ge_5 = NA_real_,
        zero_count_frequency = ifelse(n > 0, mean(counts == 0), NA_real_),
        positive_count_frequency = ifelse(n > 0, mean(counts > 0), NA_real_),
        test_method = "Bootstrap GOF",
        GOF_note = "Too few observations for Poisson goodness-of-fit assessment."
      )
    )
  }

  lambda_hat <- mean(counts)

  if (!is.finite(lambda_hat) || lambda_hat < 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        n = n,
        lambda_hat = lambda_hat,
        mean_count = mean(counts),
        var_count = stats::var(counts),
        chi_square_statistic = NA_real_,
        asymptotic_df = NA_real_,
        asymptotic_p_value = NA_real_,
        bootstrap_p_value = NA_real_,
        GOF_pass = NA,
        expected_min = NA_real_,
        expected_percent_ge_5 = NA_real_,
        zero_count_frequency = mean(counts == 0),
        positive_count_frequency = mean(counts > 0),
        test_method = "Bootstrap GOF",
        GOF_note = "Invalid Poisson rate estimate."
      )
    )
  }

  if (lambda_hat == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        n = n,
        lambda_hat = lambda_hat,
        mean_count = mean(counts),
        var_count = stats::var(counts),
        chi_square_statistic = 0,
        asymptotic_df = NA_real_,
        asymptotic_p_value = NA_real_,
        bootstrap_p_value = 1,
        GOF_pass = TRUE,
        expected_min = NA_real_,
        expected_percent_ge_5 = NA_real_,
        zero_count_frequency = mean(counts == 0),
        positive_count_frequency = mean(counts > 0),
        test_method = "Degenerate Poisson",
        GOF_note = "All counts were zero. The fitted Poisson model is degenerate at zero."
      )
    )
  }

  max_obs <- max(
    counts,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  max_model <- stats::qpois(
    p = tail_probability,
    lambda = lambda_hat
  )

  max_bin <- max(
    1,
    max_obs,
    max_model,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  compute_pearson_statistic <- function(x) {

    x <- round(x)
    lambda_x <- mean(x)

    if (!is.finite(lambda_x) || lambda_x < 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    if (lambda_x == 0) {
      return(0)
    }

    observed <- numeric(max_bin + 1)

    names(observed) <- c(
      as.character(0:(max_bin - 1)),
      paste0(">=", max_bin)
    )

    for (kk in 0:(max_bin - 1)) {
      observed[as.character(kk)] <- sum(x == kk)
    }

    observed[paste0(">=", max_bin)] <- sum(x >= max_bin)

    expected_probs <- c(
      stats::dpois(
        x = 0:(max_bin - 1),
        lambda = lambda_x
      ),
      1 - stats::ppois(
        q = max_bin - 1,
        lambda = lambda_x
      )
    )

    expected <- length(x) * expected_probs

    valid <- expected > 0

    sum(
      (observed[valid] - expected[valid])^2 / expected[valid]
    )
  }

  chi_square_statistic <- compute_pearson_statistic(counts)

  expected_probs_observed <- c(
    stats::dpois(
      x = 0:(max_bin - 1),
      lambda = lambda_hat
    ),
    1 - stats::ppois(
      q = max_bin - 1,
      lambda = lambda_hat
    )
  )

  expected_observed <- n * expected_probs_observed

  expected_min <- min(
    expected_observed[expected_observed > 0],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  expected_percent_ge_5 <- mean(
    expected_observed >= 5
  )

  asymptotic_df <- length(
    expected_observed[expected_observed > 0]
  ) - 2

  asymptotic_p_value <- if (is.finite(asymptotic_df) &&
                            asymptotic_df > 0 &&
                            is.finite(chi_square_statistic)) {
    stats::pchisq(
      q = chi_square_statistic,
      df = asymptotic_df,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  bootstrap_statistics <- replicate(
    n = n_bootstrap,
    expr = {
      x_boot <- stats::rpois(
        n = n,
        lambda = lambda_hat
      )

      compute_pearson_statistic(x_boot)
    }
  )

  bootstrap_statistics <- bootstrap_statistics[
    is.finite(bootstrap_statistics)
  ]

  bootstrap_p_value <- if (length(bootstrap_statistics) > 0 &&
                           is.finite(chi_square_statistic)) {
    mean(bootstrap_statistics >= chi_square_statistic)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  GOF_pass <- if (is.finite(bootstrap_p_value)) {
    bootstrap_p_value >= gof_alpha
  } else {
    NA
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    n = n,
    lambda_hat = lambda_hat,
    mean_count = mean(counts),
    var_count = stats::var(counts),
    chi_square_statistic = chi_square_statistic,
    asymptotic_df = asymptotic_df,
    asymptotic_p_value = asymptotic_p_value,
    bootstrap_p_value = bootstrap_p_value,
    GOF_pass = GOF_pass,
    expected_min = expected_min,
    expected_percent_ge_5 = expected_percent_ge_5,
    zero_count_frequency = mean(counts == 0),
    positive_count_frequency = mean(counts > 0),
    test_method = "Bootstrap GOF",
    GOF_note = "Pearson-type Poisson goodness-of-fit statistic with parametric bootstrap p-value."
  )
}
```

```{r poisson-u-chart-overdispersion}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

poisson_overdispersion_test <- function(counts,
                                        overdispersion_alpha = 0.05,
                                        dispersion_ratio_upper = 1.5) {

  counts <- counts[
    !is.na(counts) &
      is.finite(counts) &
      counts >= 0
  ]

  counts <- round(counts)

  n <- length(counts)

  if (n < 2) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        n = n,
        lambda_hat = ifelse(n > 0, mean(counts), NA_real_),
        mean_count = ifelse(n > 0, mean(counts), NA_real_),
        var_count = NA_real_,
        dispersion_ratio = NA_real_,
        pearson_chisq = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_overdispersion = NA_real_,
        overdispersion_pass = NA,
        substantial_overdispersion = NA,
        overdispersion_note = "Too few observations for overdispersion assessment."
      )
    )
  }

  lambda_hat <- mean(counts)
  mean_count <- mean(counts)
  var_count <- stats::var(counts)

  if (!is.finite(lambda_hat) || lambda_hat < 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        n = n,
        lambda_hat = lambda_hat,
        mean_count = mean_count,
        var_count = var_count,
        dispersion_ratio = NA_real_,
        pearson_chisq = NA_real_,
        df = n - 1,
        p_overdispersion = NA_real_,
        overdispersion_pass = NA,
        substantial_overdispersion = NA,
        overdispersion_note = "Invalid Poisson rate estimate."
      )
    )
  }

  if (lambda_hat == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        n = n,
        lambda_hat = lambda_hat,
        mean_count = mean_count,
        var_count = var_count,
        dispersion_ratio = 0,
        pearson_chisq = 0,
        df = n - 1,
        p_overdispersion = 1,
        overdispersion_pass = TRUE,
        substantial_overdispersion = FALSE,
        overdispersion_note = "All counts were zero. No overdispersion was detected."
      )
    )
  }

  dispersion_ratio <- var_count / mean_count

  pearson_chisq <- sum(
    (counts - lambda_hat)^2 / lambda_hat
  )

  df <- n - 1

  p_overdispersion <- stats::pchisq(
    q = pearson_chisq,
    df = df,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  overdispersed_by_test <- if (is.finite(p_overdispersion)) {
    p_overdispersion < overdispersion_alpha
  } else {
    NA
  }

  overdispersed_by_ratio <- if (is.finite(dispersion_ratio)) {
    dispersion_ratio > dispersion_ratio_upper
  } else {
    NA
  }

  substantial_overdispersion <- isTRUE(overdispersed_by_test) ||
    isTRUE(overdispersed_by_ratio)

  overdispersion_pass <- !substantial_overdispersion

  tibble::tibble(
    n = n,
    lambda_hat = lambda_hat,
    mean_count = mean_count,
    var_count = var_count,
    dispersion_ratio = dispersion_ratio,
    pearson_chisq = pearson_chisq,
    df = df,
    p_overdispersion = p_overdispersion,
    overdispersion_pass = overdispersion_pass,
    substantial_overdispersion = substantial_overdispersion,
    overdispersion_note = "Overdispersion was assessed using the dispersion ratio and Pearson overdispersion statistic."
  )
}
```

```{r poisson-u-chart}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

poisson_mic_u_chart <- function(
  file,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  sheet = "Mic",
  n_stage3A_events = 10,
  gof_alpha = 0.05,
  overdispersion_alpha = 0.05,
  dispersion_ratio_upper = 1.5,
  n_bootstrap = 5000,
  seed = 123,
  sigma_multiplier = 3,
  event_col = "Event",
  location_col = "Location",
  result_col = "Result",
  usl_col = "USL",
  plot_chart = FALSE,
  save_outputs = TRUE,
  output_dir = file.path(
    getwd(),
    "Poisson_U_Charts"
  )
) {

  if (save_outputs && !dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(
      output_dir,
      recursive = TRUE
    )
  }

  safe_file_name <- function(x) {
    gsub(
      pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "_",
      x = as.character(x)
    )
  }

  format_chart_value <- function(x, digits = 4) {

    if (
      length(x) == 0 ||
      is.na(x) ||
      !is.finite(x)
    ) {
      return("NA")
    }

    format(
      signif(x, digits),
      scientific = FALSE,
      trim = TRUE
    )
  }

  mic_data <- prepare_mic_data(
    file = file,
    equipment_label = equipment_label,
    sheet = sheet,
    event_col = event_col,
    location_col = location_col,
    result_col = result_col,
    usl_col = usl_col
  )

  mic_usl_values <- unique(
    mic_data$USL[
      !is.na(mic_data$USL) &
        is.finite(mic_data$USL)
    ]
  )

  if (length(mic_usl_values) == 0) {
    stop("No finite Mic USL value was found.")
  }

  mic_usl <- mic_usl_values[1]

  if (mic_usl <= 0) {
    stop("The Mic USL must be positive.")
  }

  event_statistics <- mic_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Event,
      Event_index
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Equipment = dplyr::first(Equipment),
      USL = dplyr::first(USL),
      p_t = dplyr::n(),
      Y_t = sum(
        Count,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      u_t = Y_t / p_t,
      u_t_star = 100 * u_t / USL,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      In_D_3A = Event_index <= n_stage3A_events,
      In_D_3B = Event_index > n_stage3A_events
    )

  x <- nrow(event_statistics)

  if (x < n_stage3A_events) {
    stop(
      "At least ",
      n_stage3A_events,
      " cleaning events are required. ",
      "The current number of events is ",
      x,
      "."
    )
  }

  calibration_data <- mic_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Event_index <= n_stage3A_events
    )

  calibration_event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Event_index <= n_stage3A_events
    )

  stage3A_all_zero <- all(
    calibration_data$Count == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  all_data_all_zero <- all(
    mic_data$Count == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  poisson_gof_calibration <- poisson_gof_test(
    counts = calibration_data$Count,
    gof_alpha = gof_alpha,
    n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap,
    seed = seed
  )

  poisson_gof_all <- poisson_gof_test(
    counts = mic_data$Count,
    gof_alpha = gof_alpha,
    n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap,
    seed = seed
  )

  overdispersion_calibration <- poisson_overdispersion_test(
    counts = calibration_data$Count,
    overdispersion_alpha = overdispersion_alpha,
    dispersion_ratio_upper = dispersion_ratio_upper
  )

  overdispersion_all <- poisson_overdispersion_test(
    counts = mic_data$Count,
    overdispersion_alpha = overdispersion_alpha,
    dispersion_ratio_upper = dispersion_ratio_upper
  )

  if (all_data_all_zero) {

    poisson_case <- "Case 1"

    poisson_gof_used <- poisson_gof_all
    overdispersion_used <- overdispersion_all

    selected_calibration_data <- mic_data
    selected_event_statistics <- event_statistics

    GOF_pass <- FALSE
    overdispersion_pass <- FALSE
    substantial_overdispersion <- FALSE
    Mic_Poisson <- FALSE

    poisson_model_result <-
      "All Mic counts are zero"

    decision_note <- paste(
      "All available Mic observations were zero.",
      "The Poisson u chart is degenerate and was not constructed.",
      "The d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts are used."
    )

  } else if (
    stage3A_all_zero &&
    !all_data_all_zero
  ) {

    poisson_case <- "Case 2"

    poisson_gof_used <- poisson_gof_all
    overdispersion_used <- overdispersion_all

    selected_calibration_data <- mic_data
    selected_event_statistics <- event_statistics

    GOF_pass <- isTRUE(
      poisson_gof_used$GOF_pass[1]
    )

    overdispersion_pass <- isTRUE(
      overdispersion_used$overdispersion_pass[1]
    )

    substantial_overdispersion <- isTRUE(
      overdispersion_used$substantial_overdispersion[1]
    )

    Mic_Poisson <-
      GOF_pass &&
      overdispersion_pass

    poisson_model_result <- if (Mic_Poisson) {
      "Poisson supported using all Mic observations"
    } else {
      "Poisson not supported using all Mic observations"
    }

    decision_note <- if (Mic_Poisson) {
      paste(
        "Stage 3A Mic counts were all zero, but Stage 3B",
        "contained at least one positive count.",
        "GOF and overdispersion assessments were performed",
        "using all Mic observations.",
        "The Poisson u chart is used."
      )
    } else {
      paste(
        "Stage 3A Mic counts were all zero, but Stage 3B",
        "contained at least one positive count.",
        "GOF and overdispersion assessments were performed",
        "using all Mic observations.",
        "The d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts are used."
      )
    }

  } else {

    poisson_case <- "Case 3"

    poisson_gof_used <- poisson_gof_calibration
    overdispersion_used <- overdispersion_calibration

    selected_calibration_data <- calibration_data

    selected_event_statistics <-
      calibration_event_statistics

    GOF_pass <- isTRUE(
      poisson_gof_used$GOF_pass[1]
    )

    overdispersion_pass <- isTRUE(
      overdispersion_used$overdispersion_pass[1]
    )

    substantial_overdispersion <- isTRUE(
      overdispersion_used$substantial_overdispersion[1]
    )

    Mic_Poisson <-
      GOF_pass &&
      overdispersion_pass

    poisson_model_result <- if (Mic_Poisson) {
      "Poisson supported using Stage 3A Mic observations"
    } else {
      "Poisson not supported using Stage 3A Mic observations"
    }

    decision_note <- if (Mic_Poisson) {
      paste(
        "Stage 3A contained at least one positive Mic count.",
        "GOF and overdispersion assessments were performed",
        "using Stage 3A Mic observations.",
        "The Poisson u chart is used."
      )
    } else {
      paste(
        "Stage 3A contained at least one positive Mic count.",
        "GOF and overdispersion assessments were performed",
        "using Stage 3A Mic observations.",
        "The d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts are used."
      )
    }
  }

  total_selected_count <- sum(
    selected_event_statistics$Y_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  total_selected_locations <- sum(
    selected_event_statistics$p_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (
    is.na(total_selected_locations) ||
    !is.finite(total_selected_locations) ||
    total_selected_locations <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "The selected calibration data contain no valid locations."
    )
  }

  lambda_hat_selected <-
    total_selected_count /
    total_selected_locations

  CL_u <- lambda_hat_selected
  CL_u_star <- 100 * CL_u / mic_usl

  chart_data <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CL_u = CL_u,
      CL_u_star = CL_u_star,

      UCL_u_t =
        CL_u +
        sigma_multiplier *
        sqrt(CL_u / p_t),

      UCL_u_t_star =
        100 * UCL_u_t / USL,

      Signal_Poisson_U =
        Mic_Poisson &
        u_t > UCL_u_t,

      Signal_Poisson_U_Star =
        Mic_Poisson &
        u_t_star > UCL_u_t_star,

      Stage_Status = dplyr::case_when(
        Event_index <= n_stage3A_events ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A calibration event",

        Event_index > n_stage3A_events ~
          "Stage 3B monitoring event",

        TRUE ~
          "Unclassified event"
      ),

      OOC_Event_Label = dplyr::case_when(
        Signal_Poisson_U ~
          paste0("OOC: ", Event),

        TRUE ~
          NA_character_
      )
    )

  n_ooc_events <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_Poisson_U
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  n_stage3A_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_Poisson_U,
      Event_index <= n_stage3A_events
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  n_stage3B_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_Poisson_U,
      Event_index > n_stage3A_events
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  UCL_min <- min(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_max <- max(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_star_min <- min(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_star_max <- max(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_star_is_constant <- (
    length(
      unique(
        round(
          chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
          digits = 10
        )
      )
    ) == 1
  )

  UCL_star_label <- if (UCL_star_is_constant) {

    paste0(
      "UCL = ",
      format_chart_value(
        UCL_star_max,
        digits = 4
      )
    )

  } else {

    paste0(
      "UCL = ",
      format_chart_value(
        UCL_star_min,
        digits = 4
      ),
      " to ",
      format_chart_value(
        UCL_star_max,
        digits = 4
      )
    )
  }

  CL_star_label <- paste0(
    "CL = ",
    format_chart_value(
      CL_u_star,
      digits = 4
    )
  )
  assessment_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Equipment = equipment_label,
    Case = poisson_case,
    USL = mic_usl,
    "GOF p" = poisson_gof_used$bootstrap_p_value[1],
    "GOF pass" = GOF_pass,
    Dispersion = overdispersion_used$dispersion_ratio[1],
    "OD pass" = overdispersion_pass,
    "Mic Poisson" = Mic_Poisson,
    CL = CL_u_star,
    UCL_min = UCL_star_min,
    UCL_max = UCL_star_max,
    "3A OOC" = n_stage3A_ooc,
    "3B OOC" = n_stage3B_ooc
  )

  assessment_table_detailed <- tibble::tibble(
    Equipment = equipment_label,
    poisson_case = poisson_case,
    USL = mic_usl,
    Stage3A_All_Zero = stage3A_all_zero,
    All_Data_All_Zero = all_data_all_zero,
    lambda_hat_selected = lambda_hat_selected,
    CL_u = CL_u,
    CL_u_star = CL_u_star,
    UCL_min = UCL_min,
    UCL_max = UCL_max,
    UCL_star_min = UCL_star_min,
    UCL_star_max = UCL_star_max,
    GOF_method = poisson_gof_used$test_method[1],
    GOF_chi_square_statistic =
      poisson_gof_used$chi_square_statistic[1],
    GOF_bootstrap_p_value =
      poisson_gof_used$bootstrap_p_value[1],
    GOF_asymptotic_p_value =
      poisson_gof_used$asymptotic_p_value[1],
    GOF_pass = GOF_pass,
    expected_min = poisson_gof_used$expected_min[1],
    expected_percent_ge_5 =
      poisson_gof_used$expected_percent_ge_5[1],
    zero_count_frequency =
      poisson_gof_used$zero_count_frequency[1],
    positive_count_frequency =
      poisson_gof_used$positive_count_frequency[1],
    dispersion_ratio =
      overdispersion_used$dispersion_ratio[1],
    overdispersion_p_value =
      overdispersion_used$p_overdispersion[1],
    overdispersion_pass = overdispersion_pass,
    substantial_overdispersion = substantial_overdispersion,
    Mic_Poisson = Mic_Poisson,
    use_poisson_u_chart = Mic_Poisson,
    poisson_model_result = poisson_model_result,
    n_ooc_events = n_ooc_events,
    n_stage3A_ooc = n_stage3A_ooc,
    n_stage3B_ooc = n_stage3B_ooc,
    decision_note = decision_note
  )

  plot_obj <- NULL
  chart_file <- NA_character_

  if (Mic_Poisson) {

    y_max_plot <- max(
      c(
        chart_data$u_t_star,
        chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
        chart_data$CL_u_star
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    y_upper_plot <- if (
      !is.finite(y_max_plot) ||
      y_max_plot <= 0
    ) {
      1
    } else {
      y_max_plot * 1.30
    }

    x_min_plot <- min(
      chart_data$Event_index,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    x_max_plot <- max(
      chart_data$Event_index,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    x_range_plot <- max(
      1,
      x_max_plot - x_min_plot
    )

    last_ucl_star <- chart_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Event_index == x_max_plot
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(
        UCL_u_t_star
      )

    last_ucl_star <- last_ucl_star[1]

        # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Positions for the UCL and CL labels
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    label_x <- x_max_plot - 0.03 * x_range_plot

    leader_start_x <- x_max_plot - 0.16 * x_range_plot

    leader_end_x <- x_max_plot - 0.08 * x_range_plot

    vertical_offset <- max(
      0.02 * y_upper_plot,
      0.01
    )

    ucl_label_y <- min(
      last_ucl_star + vertical_offset,
      0.96 * y_upper_plot
    )

    cl_label_y <- min(
      CL_u_star + vertical_offset,
      0.92 * y_upper_plot
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Chart title and subtitle
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    chart_title <- paste0(
      "Poisson u Chart for Mic of ",
      equipment_label
    )

    chart_subtitle <- paste0(
      "Initial Stage 3A analysis",
      " | nCal = ",
      n_stage3A_events,
      " | CL = ",
      format_chart_value(
        CL_u_star,
        digits = 4
      ),
      " | GOF p = ",
      format_chart_value(
        poisson_gof_used$bootstrap_p_value[1],
        digits = 4
      ),
      " | dispersion ratio = ",
      format_chart_value(
        overdispersion_used$dispersion_ratio[1],
        digits = 4
      )
    )

    plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      chart_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = Event_index,
        y = u_t_star,
        group = 1
      )
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        ggplot2::aes(
          color = Signal_Poisson_U
        ),
        size = 1.4
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        ggplot2::aes(
          y = UCL_u_t_star
        ),
        color = "red",
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.80
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(
        yintercept = CL_u_star,
        color = "blue",
        linetype = "solid",
        linewidth = 0.70
      ) +

      # Red leader line from the UCL to its value label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "segment",
        x = leader_start_x,
        xend = leader_end_x,
        y = last_ucl_star,
        yend = ucl_label_y,
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ) +

      # UCL value label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "text",
        x = label_x,
        y = ucl_label_y,
        label = UCL_star_label,
        color = "red",
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0,
        size = 3.2
      ) +

      # Blue leader line from the CL to its value label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "segment",
        x = leader_start_x,
        xend = leader_end_x,
        y = CL_u_star,
        yend = cl_label_y,
        color = "blue",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ) +

      # CL value label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "text",
        x = label_x,
        y = cl_label_y,
        label = CL_star_label,
        color = "blue",
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0,
        size = 3.2
      ) +

      ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = chart_data %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            Signal_Poisson_U
          ),
        ggplot2::aes(
          label = OOC_Event_Label
        ),
        color = "red",
        hjust = -0.05,
        vjust = 0.50,
        size = 3.0,
        check_overlap = TRUE,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "FALSE" = "black",
          "TRUE" = "red"
        ),
        labels = c(
          "FALSE" = "In control",
          "TRUE" = "Candidate OOC"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = chart_data$Event_index,
        labels = chart_data$Event,
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(
          mult = c(
            0.02,
            0.04
          )
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(
          0,
          y_upper_plot
        ),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(
          mult = c(
            0.01,
            0.03
          )
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = chart_title,
        subtitle = chart_subtitle,
        caption = paste0(
          "Stage 3A OOC = ",
          n_stage3A_ooc,
          "; Stage 3B OOC = ",
          n_stage3B_ooc,
          "; one-sided chart with no LCL."
        ),
        x = "Cleaning Event",
        y = expression(u[t]),
        color = "Signal"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw() +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 12,
          face = "bold"
        ),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 8
        ),
        plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 7,
          hjust = 0
        ),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor =
          ggplot2::element_blank()
      )

    if (x > n_stage3A_events) {

      boundary_x <-
        n_stage3A_events + 0.5

      plot_obj <- plot_obj +
        ggplot2::geom_vline(
          xintercept = boundary_x,
          linetype = "dotdash",
          color = "darkgreen",
          linewidth = 0.70
        ) +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          geom = "text",
          x = boundary_x +
            0.015 * x_range_plot,
          y = y_upper_plot * 0.98,
          label = "Stage 3A / 3B",
          hjust = 0,
          vjust = 1,
          size = 2.8,
          color = "darkgreen"
        )
    }

    safe_equipment <- safe_file_name(
      equipment_label
    )

    chart_file <- file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "Poisson_U_Mic_",
        safe_equipment,
        ".png"
      )
    )

    if (save_outputs) {

      ggplot2::ggsave(
        filename = chart_file,
        plot = plot_obj,
        width = 11,
        height = 6.2,
        units = "in",
        dpi = 600,
        bg = "white"
      )

      readr::write_csv(
        chart_data,
        file.path(
          output_dir,
          paste0(
            "Poisson_U_Mic_",
            safe_equipment,
            "_event_statistics.csv"
          )
        )
      )

      readr::write_csv(
        mic_data,
        file.path(
          output_dir,
          paste0(
            "Poisson_U_Mic_",
            safe_equipment,
            "_mic_data.csv"
          )
        )
      )
    }

    if (plot_chart) {
      print(plot_obj)
    }

  } else {

    message(
      paste0(
        "Poisson u chart was not generated for ",
        equipment_label,
        " because Mic_Poisson = FALSE. ",
        decision_note
      )
    )
  }

  result <- list(
    method =
      "Poisson Mic assessment and Poisson u chart",
    equipment_label = equipment_label,
    sheet = sheet,
    n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
    gof_alpha = gof_alpha,
    overdispersion_alpha =
      overdispersion_alpha,
    dispersion_ratio_upper =
      dispersion_ratio_upper,
    sigma_multiplier =
      sigma_multiplier,
    poisson_case = poisson_case,
    Stage3A_All_Zero =
      stage3A_all_zero,
    All_Data_All_Zero =
      all_data_all_zero,
    Mic_Poisson = Mic_Poisson,
    use_poisson_u_chart =
      Mic_Poisson,
    USL = mic_usl,
    lambda_hat_selected =
      lambda_hat_selected,
    CL_u = CL_u,
    CL_u_star = CL_u_star,
    UCL_min = UCL_min,
    UCL_max = UCL_max,
    UCL_star_min = UCL_star_min,
    UCL_star_max = UCL_star_max,
    assessment_table =
      assessment_table,
    assessment_table_detailed =
      assessment_table_detailed,
    poisson_gof_used =
      poisson_gof_used,
    overdispersion_used =
      overdispersion_used,
    poisson_gof_calibration =
      poisson_gof_calibration,
    poisson_gof_all =
      poisson_gof_all,
    overdispersion_calibration =
      overdispersion_calibration,
    overdispersion_all =
      overdispersion_all,
    mic_data = mic_data,
    event_statistics = chart_data,
    selected_calibration_data =
      selected_calibration_data,
    selected_event_statistics =
      selected_event_statistics,
    calibration_data =
      calibration_data,
    calibration_event_statistics =
      calibration_event_statistics,
    chart = plot_obj,
    files = list(
      chart_file = chart_file
    )
  )

  class(result) <- c(
    "poisson_mic_u_chart",
    "list"
  )

  return(result)
}
```

```{r poisson-u-chart_exact_Poisson}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

poisson_mic_u_chart_exact <- function(
  file,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  sheet = "Mic",
  n_stage3A_events = 10,
  gof_alpha = 0.05,
  overdispersion_alpha = 0.05,
  dispersion_ratio_upper = 1.5,
  n_bootstrap = 5000,
  seed = 123,
  ARL0 = 740,
  event_col = "Event",
  location_col = "Location",
  result_col = "Result",
  usl_col = "USL",
  plot_chart = FALSE,
  save_outputs = TRUE,
  output_dir = file.path(
    getwd(),
    "Poisson_U_Charts_Exact"
  )
) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validate inputs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    length(ARL0) != 1 ||
    is.na(ARL0) ||
    !is.finite(ARL0) ||
    ARL0 <= 1
  ) {
    stop(
      "ARL0 must be a single finite number greater than 1."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(n_stage3A_events) != 1 ||
    is.na(n_stage3A_events) ||
    !is.finite(n_stage3A_events) ||
    n_stage3A_events < 1 ||
    abs(
      n_stage3A_events -
        round(n_stage3A_events)
    ) > 1e-8
  ) {
    stop(
      "n_stage3A_events must be a positive integer."
    )
  }

  n_stage3A_events <- as.integer(
    round(n_stage3A_events)
  )

  control_alpha <- 1 / ARL0

  if (
    !is.finite(control_alpha) ||
    control_alpha <= 0 ||
    control_alpha >= 1
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "The control-chart alpha calculated",
        "from ARL0 is invalid."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    save_outputs &&
    !dir.exists(output_dir)
  ) {
    dir.create(
      output_dir,
      recursive = TRUE
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Supporting functions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  safe_file_name <- function(x) {

    gsub(
      pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "_",
      x = as.character(x)
    )
  }

  format_chart_value <- function(
    x,
    digits = 4
  ) {

    if (
      length(x) == 0 ||
      is.na(x[1]) ||
      !is.finite(x[1])
    ) {
      return("NA")
    }

    format(
      signif(
        x[1],
        digits
      ),
      scientific = FALSE,
      trim = TRUE
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare individual-location Mic data
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mic_data <- prepare_mic_data(
    file = file,
    equipment_label = equipment_label,
    sheet = sheet,
    event_col = event_col,
    location_col = location_col,
    result_col = result_col,
    usl_col = usl_col
  )

  mic_usl_values <- unique(
    mic_data$USL[
      !is.na(mic_data$USL) &
        is.finite(mic_data$USL)
    ]
  )

  if (length(mic_usl_values) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No finite Mic USL value was found."
    )
  }

  if (length(mic_usl_values) != 1) {
    stop(
      "Mic data must have one common USL. ",
      "The current number of unique finite USL values is ",
      length(mic_usl_values),
      "."
    )
  }

  mic_usl <- mic_usl_values[1]

  if (mic_usl <= 0) {
    stop(
      "The Mic USL must be positive."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 1: Calculate event-level microbial statistics
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  event_statistics <- mic_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Event,
      Event_index
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Equipment =   dplyr::first(Equipment),
      USL =        dplyr::first(USL),
      p_t =  dplyr::n(),
      Y_t = sum(Count,  na.rm = TRUE  ),
      u_t =        Y_t / p_t,
      u_t_star =  100 * u_t / USL,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% dplyr::arrange( Event_index )

  x <- nrow(event_statistics)

  if (x < 1) {
    stop(
      "No usable cleaning events were found."
    )
  }

  n_stage3A_available <- min(
    x,
    n_stage3A_events
  )

  event_statistics <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      In_D_3A =
        Event_index <= n_stage3A_events,

      In_D_3B =
        Event_index > n_stage3A_events
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 2: Create nominal Stage 3A and Stage 3B datasets
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  calibration_data <- mic_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Event_index <= n_stage3A_events
    )

  calibration_event_statistics <-
    event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Event_index <= n_stage3A_events
    )

  stage3B_data <- mic_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Event_index > n_stage3A_events
    )

  stage3B_event_statistics <-
    event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Event_index > n_stage3A_events
    )

  stage3A_all_zero <- all(
    calibration_data$Count == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  all_data_all_zero <- all(
    mic_data$Count == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  stage3B_has_positive <- any(
    stage3B_data$Count > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Goodness-of-fit and overdispersion assessments
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  poisson_gof_calibration <- poisson_gof_test(
    counts = calibration_data$Count,
    gof_alpha = gof_alpha,
    n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap,
    seed = seed
  )

  poisson_gof_all <- poisson_gof_test(
    counts = mic_data$Count,
    gof_alpha = gof_alpha,
    n_bootstrap = n_bootstrap,
    seed = seed
  )

  overdispersion_calibration <-
    poisson_overdispersion_test(
      counts = calibration_data$Count,
      overdispersion_alpha =        overdispersion_alpha,
      dispersion_ratio_upper =        dispersion_ratio_upper
    )

  overdispersion_all <-
    poisson_overdispersion_test(
      counts = mic_data$Count,
      overdispersion_alpha =        overdispersion_alpha,
      dispersion_ratio_upper =        dispersion_ratio_upper
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 3: Select the Poisson-assessment dataset
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (all_data_all_zero) {

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Case 1: All available Mic counts are zero
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    poisson_case <- "Case 1"

    poisson_gof_used <-      poisson_gof_all

    overdispersion_used <-      overdispersion_all

    selected_calibration_data <-      mic_data

    selected_event_statistics <-      event_statistics

    GOF_pass <- FALSE

    overdispersion_pass <- FALSE

    substantial_overdispersion <- FALSE

    Mic_Poisson <- FALSE

    calibration_dataset_label <-
      "All currently available Mic observations"

    poisson_model_result <-
      "All Mic counts are zero"

    decision_note <- paste(
      "All available Mic observations were zero.",
      "The Poisson u chart is degenerate and was not constructed.",
      "The d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts are used."
    )

  } else if (
    stage3A_all_zero &&
    stage3B_has_positive
  ) {

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Case 2: Stage 3A is zero and Stage 3B has a positive count
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    poisson_case <- "Case 2"

    poisson_gof_used <-      poisson_gof_all

    overdispersion_used <-      overdispersion_all

    selected_calibration_data <-      mic_data

    selected_event_statistics <-      event_statistics

    GOF_pass <- isTRUE( poisson_gof_used$GOF_pass[1]    )

    overdispersion_pass <- isTRUE(overdispersion_used$overdispersion_pass[1])

    substantial_overdispersion <- isTRUE(overdispersion_used$substantial_overdispersion[1] )

    Mic_Poisson <-  GOF_pass && overdispersion_pass

    calibration_dataset_label <-  "All currently available Mic observations"

    poisson_model_result <- if (Mic_Poisson) {"Poisson supported using all Mic observations"} else {"Poisson not supported using all Mic observations"}

    decision_note <- if (Mic_Poisson) {

      paste(
        "Stage 3A Mic counts were all zero, but Stage 3B",
        "contained at least one positive count.",
        "The goodness-of-fit and overdispersion assessments",
        "were performed using all currently available Mic",
        "observations. The exact one-sided Poisson u chart",
        "is used, and the resulting chart parameters are",
        "retained for monitoring future cleaning events."
      )

    } else {

      paste(
        "Stage 3A Mic counts were all zero, but Stage 3B",
        "contained at least one positive count.",
        "The goodness-of-fit and overdispersion assessments",
        "were performed using all currently available Mic",
        "observations. The Poisson model was not supported,",
        "so the d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts are used."
      )
    }

  } else {

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Case 3: Stage 3A contains at least one positive count
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    poisson_case <- "Case 3"

    poisson_gof_used <-      poisson_gof_calibration

    overdispersion_used <-      overdispersion_calibration

    selected_calibration_data <-      calibration_data

    selected_event_statistics <-      calibration_event_statistics

    GOF_pass <- isTRUE(      poisson_gof_used$GOF_pass[1]    )

    overdispersion_pass <- isTRUE(      overdispersion_used$overdispersion_pass[1]  )

    substantial_overdispersion <- isTRUE(      overdispersion_used$substantial_overdispersion[1])

    Mic_Poisson <-      GOF_pass &&overdispersion_pass

    calibration_dataset_label <-      "Nominal Stage 3A Mic observations"

    poisson_model_result <- if (Mic_Poisson) {

      "Poisson supported using Stage 3A Mic observations"

    } else {

      "Poisson not supported using Stage 3A Mic observations"
    }

    decision_note <- if (Mic_Poisson) {

      paste(
        "Stage 3A contained at least one positive Mic count.",
        "The goodness-of-fit and overdispersion assessments",
        "were performed using Stage 3A Mic observations.",
        "The exact one-sided Poisson u chart is used.",
        "The Stage 3A rate estimate and control limits are",
        "retained for Stage 3B monitoring."
      )

    } else {

      paste(
        "Stage 3A contained at least one positive Mic count.",
        "The goodness-of-fit and overdispersion assessments",
        "were performed using Stage 3A Mic observations.",
        "The Poisson model was not supported, so the",
        "d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts are used."
      )
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 4: Estimate the Poisson rate
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  total_selected_count <- sum(
    selected_event_statistics$Y_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  total_selected_locations <- sum(
    selected_event_statistics$p_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (
    is.na(total_selected_locations) ||
    !is.finite(total_selected_locations) ||
    total_selected_locations <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "The selected calibration data contain no valid locations."
    )
  }

  lambda_hat_selected <-    total_selected_count/total_selected_locations

  CL_u <- lambda_hat_selected

  CL_u_star <-    100 * CL_u / mic_usl

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 8: Exact one-sided Poisson upper control limit
  #
  # Y_t ~ Poisson(p_t * CL_u)
  #
  # UCL_Y,t =   qpois(1 - alpha, lambda = p_t * CL_u)
  #
  # UCL_u,t =   UCL_Y,t / p_t
  #
  # No LCL is calculated because lower microbial residue
  # indicates improved cleaning performance. We do not use normal approximation
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  chart_data <- event_statistics %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CL_u =        CL_u,
      CL_u_star =        CL_u_star,
      Poisson_mean_Y_t =        p_t * CL_u,

      UCL_Y_t = stats::qpois(
        p = 1 - control_alpha,
        lambda = Poisson_mean_Y_t,
        lower.tail = TRUE
      ),
      UCL_u_t =   UCL_Y_t / p_t,
      UCL_u_t_star =    100 * UCL_u_t / USL,
      Achieved_alpha_t = stats::ppois(
        q = UCL_Y_t,
        lambda = Poisson_mean_Y_t,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      ),

      Achieved_ARL0_t = dplyr::if_else(
        Achieved_alpha_t > 0,
        1 / Achieved_alpha_t,
        Inf
      ),

      Signal_Poisson_U =
        Mic_Poisson &
        Y_t > UCL_Y_t,

      Signal_Poisson_U_Star =
        Mic_Poisson &
        u_t_star > UCL_u_t_star,

      Signal_Definitions_Agree =
        Signal_Poisson_U ==
        Signal_Poisson_U_Star,

      Stage_Status = dplyr::case_when(
        Event_index <= n_stage3A_events ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A calibration event",

        Event_index > n_stage3A_events ~
          "Stage 3B monitoring event",

        TRUE ~
          "Unclassified event"
      ),

      OOC_Event_Label = dplyr::case_when(
        Signal_Poisson_U ~
          paste0(
            "OOC: ",
            Event
          ),

        TRUE ~
          NA_character_
      )
    )

  if (
    any(
      !chart_data$Signal_Definitions_Agree,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) {
    warning(
      paste(
        "The signals calculated from the total-count scale",
        "and normalized density scale were not identical.",
        "The primary exact-Poisson criterion",
        "Y_t > UCL_Y_t is retained."
      )
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Count candidate out-of-control events
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  n_ooc_events <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_Poisson_U
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  n_stage3A_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_Poisson_U,
      Event_index <= n_stage3A_events
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  n_stage3B_ooc <- chart_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_Poisson_U,
      Event_index > n_stage3A_events
    ) %>%
    nrow()

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Summarize exact control limits
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  UCL_Y_min <- min(
    chart_data$UCL_Y_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_Y_max <- max(
    chart_data$UCL_Y_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_min <- min(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_max <- max(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_star_min <- min(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_star_max <- max(
    chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  achieved_alpha_min <- min(
    chart_data$Achieved_alpha_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  achieved_alpha_max <- max(
    chart_data$Achieved_alpha_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  achieved_ARL0_min <- min(
    chart_data$Achieved_ARL0_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  achieved_ARL0_max <- max(
    chart_data$Achieved_ARL0_t,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  UCL_star_is_constant <- (
    length(
      unique(
        round(
          chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
          digits = 10
        )
      )
    ) == 1
  )

  UCL_Y_is_constant <- (
    length(
      unique(
        chart_data$UCL_Y_t
      )
    ) == 1
  )

  UCL_star_label <- if (UCL_star_is_constant) {

    paste0(
      "UCL = ",
      format_chart_value(
        UCL_star_max,
        digits = 4
      )
    )

  } else {

    paste0(
      "UCL = ",
      format_chart_value(
        UCL_star_min,
        digits = 4
      ),
      " to ",
      format_chart_value(
        UCL_star_max,
        digits = 4
      )
    )
  }

  CL_star_label <- paste0(
    "CL = ",
    format_chart_value(
      CL_u_star,
      digits = 4
    )
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Assessment tables
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  assessment_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Equipment =      equipment_label,

    Case =      poisson_case,

    USL =      mic_usl,

    ARL0 =      ARL0,

    alpha =      control_alpha,

    "GOF p" =      poisson_gof_used$bootstrap_p_value[1],

    "GOF pass" =      GOF_pass,

    Dispersion =      overdispersion_used$dispersion_ratio[1],

    "OD pass" =      overdispersion_pass,

    "Mic Poisson" =      Mic_Poisson,

    CL =      CL_u_star,

    UCL_Y_min =      UCL_Y_min,

    UCL_Y_max =      UCL_Y_max,

    UCL_min =      UCL_star_min,

    UCL_max =      UCL_star_max,

    "3A OOC" =      n_stage3A_ooc,

    "3B OOC" =      n_stage3B_ooc
  )

  assessment_table_detailed <- tibble::tibble(
    Equipment =      equipment_label,

    poisson_case =      poisson_case,

    calibration_dataset =      calibration_dataset_label,

    USL =      mic_usl,

    nominal_ARL0 =      ARL0,

    nominal_alpha =      control_alpha,

    control_limit_method =      "Exact one-sided Poisson quantile",

    lower_control_limit_used =      FALSE,

    lower_control_limit_note =      paste(
        "No LCL is used because lower microbial residue",
        "counts indicate improved cleaning performance."
      ),

    n_available_events =      x,

    n_nominal_stage3A_events =      n_stage3A_events,

    n_available_stage3A_events =      n_stage3A_available,

    n_available_stage3B_events =      nrow(stage3B_event_statistics),

    Stage3A_All_Zero =      stage3A_all_zero,

    Stage3B_Has_Positive =      stage3B_has_positive,

    All_Data_All_Zero =      all_data_all_zero,

    total_selected_count =      total_selected_count,

    total_selected_locations =      total_selected_locations,

    lambda_hat_selected =      lambda_hat_selected,

    CL_u =      CL_u,

    CL_u_star =      CL_u_star,

    UCL_Y_is_constant =      UCL_Y_is_constant,

    UCL_Y_min =      UCL_Y_min,

    UCL_Y_max =      UCL_Y_max,

    UCL_min =      UCL_min,

    UCL_max =
      UCL_max,

    UCL_star_min =      UCL_star_min,

    UCL_star_max =      UCL_star_max,

    achieved_alpha_min =      achieved_alpha_min,

    achieved_alpha_max =      achieved_alpha_max,

    achieved_ARL0_min =      achieved_ARL0_min,

    achieved_ARL0_max =      achieved_ARL0_max,

    GOF_method =      poisson_gof_used$test_method[1],

    GOF_chi_square_statistic =      poisson_gof_used$chi_square_statistic[1],

    GOF_bootstrap_p_value =      poisson_gof_used$bootstrap_p_value[1],

    GOF_asymptotic_p_value =      poisson_gof_used$asymptotic_p_value[1],

    GOF_pass =      GOF_pass,

    expected_min =      poisson_gof_used$expected_min[1],

    expected_percent_ge_5 =      poisson_gof_used$expected_percent_ge_5[1],

    zero_count_frequency =      poisson_gof_used$zero_count_frequency[1],

    positive_count_frequency =      poisson_gof_used$positive_count_frequency[1],

    dispersion_ratio =    overdispersion_used$dispersion_ratio[1],

    overdispersion_p_value =      overdispersion_used$p_overdispersion[1],

    overdispersion_pass =      overdispersion_pass,

    substantial_overdispersion =      substantial_overdispersion,

    Mic_Poisson =      Mic_Poisson,

    use_poisson_u_chart =      Mic_Poisson,

    poisson_model_result =      poisson_model_result,

    n_ooc_events =      n_ooc_events,

    n_stage3A_ooc =      n_stage3A_ooc,

    n_stage3B_ooc =      n_stage3B_ooc,

    decision_note =      decision_note
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Initialize output objects and filenames
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  plot_obj <- NULL

  chart_file <- NA_character_

  event_statistics_file <- NA_character_

  mic_data_file <- NA_character_

  assessment_file <- NA_character_

  assessment_detailed_file <- NA_character_
  
  jpeg_file <- NA_character_

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Construct the chart only when Poisson is selected
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (Mic_Poisson) {

    y_max_plot <- max(
      c(
        chart_data$u_t_star,
        chart_data$UCL_u_t_star,
        chart_data$CL_u_star
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    y_upper_plot <- if (
      !is.finite(y_max_plot) ||
      y_max_plot <= 0
    ) {

      1

    } else {

      y_max_plot * 1.30
    }

    x_min_plot <- min(
      chart_data$Event_index,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    x_max_plot <- max(
      chart_data$Event_index,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    x_range_plot <- max(
      1,
      x_max_plot - x_min_plot
    )

    last_ucl_star <- chart_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Event_index == x_max_plot
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(
        UCL_u_t_star
      )

    last_ucl_star <-
      last_ucl_star[1]

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Positions for UCL and CL labels
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    label_x <-
      x_max_plot -
      0.03 * x_range_plot

    leader_start_x <-
      x_max_plot -
      0.16 * x_range_plot

    leader_end_x <-
      x_max_plot -
      0.08 * x_range_plot

    vertical_offset <- max(
      0.02 * y_upper_plot,
      0.01
    )

    ucl_label_y <- min(
      last_ucl_star + vertical_offset,
      0.96 * y_upper_plot
    )

    cl_label_y <- min(
      CL_u_star + vertical_offset,
      0.92 * y_upper_plot
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Chart title and subtitle
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    chart_title <- paste0(
      "Exact Poisson u Chart for Mic of ",
      equipment_label
    )

    calibration_subtitle <- if (
      poisson_case == "Case 2"
    ) {

      paste0(
        "All currently available observations used for calibration",
        " | nCal events = ",
        nrow(selected_event_statistics)
      )

    } else {

      paste0(
        "Stage 3A calibration",
        " | nCal events = ",
        nrow(selected_event_statistics)
      )
    }

    chart_subtitle <- paste0(calibration_subtitle,
      " | exact one-sided Poisson UCL",
      " | ARL0 = ",
      format_chart_value(
        ARL0,
        digits = 6
      ),
      " | CL = ",
      format_chart_value(
        CL_u_star,
        digits = 4
      ),
      " | GOF p = ",
      format_chart_value(
        poisson_gof_used$
          bootstrap_p_value[1],
        digits = 4
      ),
      " | dispersion ratio = ",
      format_chart_value(
        overdispersion_used$
          dispersion_ratio[1],
        digits = 4
      )
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Exact one-sided Poisson u chart
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      chart_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = Event_index,
        y = u_t_star,
        group = 1
      )
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        ggplot2::aes(
          color = Signal_Poisson_U
        ),
        size = 1.4
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_step(
        ggplot2::aes(
          y = UCL_u_t_star
        ),
        direction = "mid",
        color = "red",
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.80
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(
        yintercept = CL_u_star,
        color = "blue",
        linetype = "solid",
        linewidth = 0.70
      ) +

      # Red leader line from the UCL to its label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "segment",
        x = leader_start_x,
        xend = leader_end_x,
        y = last_ucl_star,
        yend = ucl_label_y,
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ) +

      # UCL value label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "text",
        x = label_x,
        y = ucl_label_y,
        label = UCL_star_label,
        color = "red",
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0,
        size = 3.2
      ) +

      # Blue leader line from the CL to its label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "segment",
        x = leader_start_x,
        xend = leader_end_x,
        y = CL_u_star,
        yend = cl_label_y,
        color = "blue",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ) +

      # CL value label
      ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "text",
        x = label_x,
        y = cl_label_y,
        label = CL_star_label,
        color = "blue",
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0,
        size = 3.2
      ) +

      # Candidate OOC event labels
      ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = chart_data %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            Signal_Poisson_U
          ),
        ggplot2::aes(
          label = OOC_Event_Label
        ),
        color = "red",
        hjust = -0.05,
        vjust = 0.50,
        size = 3.0,
        check_overlap = TRUE,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +

      ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "FALSE" = "black",
          "TRUE" = "red"
        ),
        labels = c(
          "FALSE" = "In control",
          "TRUE" = "Candidate OOC"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +

      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        breaks =
          chart_data$Event_index,
        labels =
          chart_data$Event,
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(
          mult = c(
            0.02,
            0.04
          )
        )
      ) +

      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(
          0,
          y_upper_plot
        ),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(
          mult = c(
            0.01,
            0.03
          )
        )
      ) +

      ggplot2::labs(
        title =
          chart_title,

        subtitle =
          chart_subtitle,

        caption = paste0(
          "Exact UCL: qpois(1 - 1/ARL0, p[t] * u-bar) / p[t]; ",
          "Stage 3A OOC = ",
          n_stage3A_ooc,
          "; Stage 3B OOC = ",
          n_stage3B_ooc,
          ". One-sided upper chart only; no LCL is used because ",
          "lower microbial residue indicates improved cleaning performance."
        ),

        x =
          "Cleaning Event",

        y = expression(
          u[t]^"* (% of microbial USL)"
        ),

        color =
          "Signal"
      ) +

      ggplot2::theme_bw() +

      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 12,
          face = "bold"
        ),

        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 8
        ),

        plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 7,
          hjust = 0
        ),

        legend.position =
          "bottom",

        panel.grid.minor =
          ggplot2::element_blank()
      )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Stage 3A and Stage 3B boundary
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    if (x > n_stage3A_events) {

      boundary_x <-
        n_stage3A_events + 0.5

      plot_obj <- plot_obj +
        ggplot2::geom_vline(
          xintercept =
            boundary_x,
          linetype =
            "dotdash",
          color =
            "darkgreen",
          linewidth =
            0.70
        ) +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          geom =
            "text",
          x =
            boundary_x +
            0.015 * x_range_plot,
          y =
            y_upper_plot * 0.98,
          label =
            "Stage 3A / 3B",
          hjust =
            0,
          vjust =
            1,
          size =
            2.8,
          color =
            "darkgreen"
        )
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Separate filenames for the exact-Poisson outputs
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    safe_equipment <- safe_file_name(
      equipment_label
    )

    chart_file <- file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "Poisson_U_Exact_Mic_",
        safe_equipment,
        ".png"
      )
    )

    event_statistics_file <- file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "Poisson_U_Exact_Mic_",
        safe_equipment,
        "_event_statistics.csv"
      )
    )

    mic_data_file <- file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "Poisson_U_Exact_Mic_",
        safe_equipment,
        "_mic_data.csv"
      )
    )

    assessment_file <- file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "Poisson_U_Exact_Mic_",
        safe_equipment,
        "_assessment.csv"
      )
    )

    assessment_detailed_file <- file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "Poisson_U_Exact_Mic_",
        safe_equipment,
        "_assessment_detailed.csv"
      )
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Save chart and analysis data
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    if (save_outputs) {

      ggplot2::ggsave(
        filename =  chart_file,
        plot =      plot_obj,
        width =     11,
        height =    6.2,
        units =    "in",
        dpi =      600,
        bg =      "white"
      )
      
jpeg_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  paste0("Poisson_U_Exact_Mic_",safe_equipment, ".jpeg" ))

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = jpeg_file,
  plot = plot_obj,
  width = 11,
  height = 6.2,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white",
  device = "jpeg"
)

      readr::write_csv(
        chart_data,
        event_statistics_file
      )

      readr::write_csv(  mic_data,mic_data_file)

      readr::write_csv( assessment_table,  assessment_file  )

      readr::write_csv( assessment_table_detailed,assessment_detailed_file)
    }

    if (plot_chart) { print(plot_obj) }

  } else {

    message(
      paste0(
        "Exact Poisson u chart was not generated for ",
        equipment_label,
        " because Mic_Poisson = FALSE. ",
        decision_note
      )
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return analysis results
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  result <- list(
    method =paste("Poisson Mic assessment and exact one-sided", "Poisson u chart" ),

    function_name =  "poisson_mic_u_chart_exact",

    equipment_label =      equipment_label,

    sheet =      sheet,

    n_stage3A_events =      n_stage3A_events,

    n_available_events =      x,

    n_available_stage3A_events =      n_stage3A_available,

    n_available_stage3B_events =      nrow(stage3B_event_statistics),

    gof_alpha =      gof_alpha,

    overdispersion_alpha =      overdispersion_alpha,

    dispersion_ratio_upper =      dispersion_ratio_upper,

    ARL0 =      ARL0,

    control_alpha =      control_alpha,

    control_limit_method =      "Exact one-sided Poisson quantile",

    lower_control_limit_used =      FALSE,

    lower_control_limit_note =    paste("No LCL is used because lower microbial residue", "counts indicate improved cleaning performance."),

    poisson_case =      poisson_case,

    calibration_dataset =      calibration_dataset_label,

    Stage3A_All_Zero =      stage3A_all_zero,

    Stage3B_Has_Positive =      stage3B_has_positive,

    All_Data_All_Zero =      all_data_all_zero,

    Mic_Poisson =      Mic_Poisson,

    use_poisson_u_chart =      Mic_Poisson,

    USL =      mic_usl,

    total_selected_count =      total_selected_count,

    total_selected_locations =      total_selected_locations,

    lambda_hat_selected =      lambda_hat_selected,

    CL_u =      CL_u,

    CL_u_star =      CL_u_star,

    UCL_Y_min =      UCL_Y_min,

    UCL_Y_max =      UCL_Y_max,

    UCL_min =      UCL_min,

    UCL_max =      UCL_max,

    UCL_star_min =      UCL_star_min,

    UCL_star_max =      UCL_star_max,

    achieved_alpha_min =      achieved_alpha_min,

    achieved_alpha_max =      achieved_alpha_max,

    achieved_ARL0_min =      achieved_ARL0_min,

    achieved_ARL0_max =      achieved_ARL0_max,

    assessment_table =      assessment_table,

    assessment_table_detailed =      assessment_table_detailed,

    poisson_gof_used =      poisson_gof_used,

    overdispersion_used =      overdispersion_used,

    poisson_gof_calibration =      poisson_gof_calibration,

    poisson_gof_all =      poisson_gof_all,

    overdispersion_calibration =      overdispersion_calibration,

    overdispersion_all =      overdispersion_all,

    mic_data =      mic_data,

    event_statistics =      chart_data,

    selected_calibration_data =      selected_calibration_data,

    selected_event_statistics =      selected_event_statistics,

    calibration_data =      calibration_data,

    calibration_event_statistics =      calibration_event_statistics,

    stage3B_data =      stage3B_data,

    stage3B_event_statistics =      stage3B_event_statistics,

    chart =      plot_obj,

    output_dir =      output_dir,
    
    files = list(  chart_file = chart_file,

  jpeg_file = jpeg_file,

  event_statistics_file =    event_statistics_file,

  mic_data_file =    mic_data_file,

  assessment_file =    assessment_file,

  assessment_detailed_file =    assessment_detailed_file) )

  class(result) <- c(  "poisson_mic_u_chart_exact",   "poisson_mic_u_chart",  "list"  )

  return(result)
}
```

Figure \ref{fig:poisson-u-comparison-equipment-a} provides the conventional $3\sigma$ Poisson $u$ chart and the exact Poisson-quantile $u$ chart for Mic data from Equipment A. No OOC signals were identified by either chart, indicating stable microbial process performance. The conventional $3\sigma$ Poisson $u$ chart produced a UCL of 2.0974, whereas the exact Poisson-quantile $u$ chart produced a UCL of 4. The conventional $3\sigma$ Poisson $u$ chart in Figure \ref{fig:poisson-u-comparison-equipment-a} is highly consistent with the d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts in Figure \ref{fig:d-ccssbu-mic-equipment-ab}. This similarity arises from the structure of the data. Each cleaning event contains two observations, for which the event mean and median are identical. Moreover, the only event with nonzero microbial counts (Event 7) has observations of 0 and 1, yielding a mean, median, and MAD of 0.5. After USL-normalization, both the location statistic $L_t$ and scale statistic $S_t$ equal 2. As a result, the d-CCSSBU-L chart, d-CCSSBU-S chart, and conventional $3\sigma$ Poisson $u$ chart produced similar chart patterns and identical monitoring conclusions for Equipment A. In contrast, the exact Poisson-quantile $u$ chart produced a substantially larger UCL, although it likewise resulted in no OOC signals and the same overall stability assessment.

### Non-Poisson Mic Data of Equipment B

Table \ref{tab:poisson-u-assessment-equipment-b} shows the Mic data for Equipment B do not satisfy the Poisson assumptions. The goodness-of-fit test failed ($p=0.0274$), and the overdispersion assessment also failed with a dispersion ratio of 1.6286. Consequently, the Mic data were not considered Poisson, and a Poisson $u$ chart was not appropriate. This conclusion is also supported by the d-CCSSBU charts. Unlike Equipment A, where the d-CCSSBU-L and d-CCSSBU-S charts were nearly identical and closely matched the $3\sigma$ Poisson $u$ chart, the location and scale charts for Equipment B exhibit different patterns. The visual differences between the two charts indicate that the underlying process behavior is not consistent with a simple Poisson mechanism.
